bangladesh_bhutan_discuss_bilateral_coop.institution: Bangladesh Bank & Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan
bangladesh_bhutan_discuss_bilateral_coop.headline: Bangladesh and Bhutan Boost Bilateral Trade at IMF‑WB Annual Meeting
bangladesh_bhutan_discuss_bilateral_coop.summary: Bangladesh Bank Governor Md Mostaqur Rahman and Bhutan’s RMA Governor Yangchen Tshogyel discussed expanding trade ties and SAARCFINANCE cooperation during the IMF‑WB gatherings.
highlights: Governors exchanged views on strengthening bilateral trade between Bangladesh and Bhutan
Discussions included the SAARCFINANCE working group, a SAARC central bank network
Deputy governors Dr Md Habibur Rahman and Ms Uygen Choden attended the meeting

larry_fink_warns_data_center_moratorium_.headline: BlackRock CEO Warns Data Center Moratorium Could Spark Recession
larry_fink_warns_data_center_moratorium_.summary: Larry Fink cautioned that halting data‑center construction, a key driver of AI capex, could push the U.S. economy into recession despite misinformation concerns.
highlights: BlackRock reported better‑than‑expected third‑quarter earnings
Analysts project AI capital expenditures to exceed $1 trillion in 2027 and $5 trillion by 2030

container_ship_sinks_in_strait_of_hormuz.institution: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
container_ship_sinks_in_strait_of_hormuz.headline: Container Ship Sinks in Strait of Hormuz Amid Iran’s Escalated Attacks
container_ship_sinks_in_strait_of_hormuz.summary: The Singapore‑registered GFS Pride was hit by an unknown projectile, caught fire and sank, while Iran’s heightened assaults threaten commercial shipping through the strategic strait.
highlights: The GFS Pride’s 21 crew were evacuated safely with no injuries reported.
Iran’s Revolutionary Guard alleges a naval mine caused the sinking, though independent firms find no evidence.
Crude oil flows through Hormuz fell to 8.5 million barrels per day, about 40% below pre‑war levels.

aramco_facility_attacked_by_houthi_milit.headline: Iran-Backed Houthis Attack Saudi Aramco Facility as Tehran Vows to Sink U.S. Warships
aramco_facility_attacked_by_houthi_milit.summary: Saudi Aramco’s Dhahran building was hit by a Houthi strike, sparking a fire while Iran’s IRGC chief warned it will sink U.S. warships in the Strait of Hormuz.
highlights: The strike caused a fire but no injuries were reported at the Dhahran site.
King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh remains closed after earlier Houthi attacks.
A cargo ship reportedly caught fire and sank in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine.

foreign_banks_net_profit_falls_38_in_h1.headline: Foreign Banks' Net Profit Plummets 38% in Bangladesh H1 2026
foreign_banks_net_profit_falls_38_in_h1.summary: Foreign commercial banks in Bangladesh saw net profit drop 38% to Tk2,321 crore in H1 2026 amid weaker trade and limited income opportunities.
highlights: Non‑performing loan ratio rose to 6.5% while capital adequacy stayed robust at 41.21%.
Foreign banks processed $3.95 billion in export receipts, representing 18.6% of total exports.

tender_offer_90b.headline: Anduril Tender Offer Values Defense Tech Startup at $90 Billion
tender_offer_90b.summary: Anduril is offering employees a tender to sell shares at $94.80 each, potentially valuing the defense‑tech firm at about $90 billion.
highlights: The offer caps at $1.3 billion and runs until Nov. 9
Employees in 16 countries can participate
Anduril recently secured a U.S. Navy shipyard contract worth up to $2.9 billion

stock_plunge_ai_spending.headline: Dell Shares Drop 11% Triggering Data Center Sell‑Off Over AI Timing Concerns
stock_plunge_ai_spending.summary: Dell’s 11% plunge sparked a broader sell‑off in data‑center stocks as investors doubt enterprise AI spending will sustain the current build‑out.
highlights: Dell fell 11% while Hewlett‑Packard Enterprise, Oracle and Super Micro also declined.
Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE and NetApp, citing lack of meaningful enterprise AI inflection.
Memory prices and rising interest rates are pressuring AI‑related hardware revenue.

tbsnews.net/world/denmark-says-us-resour.headline: Denmark Says US Resource Exploration in Greenland Must Follow Local Laws
tbsnews.net/world/denmark-says-us-resour.summary: Denmark's foreign ministry warned that any US oil, gas or mineral exploration in Greenland must comply with the island's legislation, despite recent security agreements.
highlights: The September agreement allows increased US military presence but grants no mining or drilling rights.
Greenland banned uranium mining and all new oil exploration in 2021.
Trump claimed massive resource potential despite the island's existing prohibitions.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/1702-candidates-a.headline: Bangladesh Appoints 1,702 Candidates Under 45th BCS Examination
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/1702-candidates-a.summary: The government has confirmed the appointment of 1,702 candidates to various civil service cadres, requiring them to report to their designated ministries by 1 November.
highlights: 1,702 candidates were appointed, slightly fewer than the 1,807 recommended by the PSC.
Appointees must join their assigned offices by 1 November or risk cancellation of their appointment.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/garment-workers-b.headline: Garment Workers Block Uttara Road Again Over Tk30,000 Wage Demand
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/garment-workers-b.summary: Repeated protests by garment workers in Azampur, Uttara, demanding a minimum monthly wage of Tk30,000 have caused severe traffic jams on the Dhaka‑Mymensingh highway.
highlights: Road blockage halted traffic on one side of the highway, stranding commuters and forcing some to walk.
Additional Deputy Commissioner Md Al Amin Sarkar negotiated reopening of one lane after talks with protesters.

cnbc.com/2026/10/15/sk-hynix-samsung-sof.headline: SK Hynix Slides Over 10% as Fed Rate Hike Fears Hit Asian Chip Sector
cnbc.com/2026/10/15/sk-hynix-samsung-sof.summary: Asian chipmakers tumbled amid rising U.S. inflation worries, with investors fearing higher Fed rates and costly AI financing could curb capital spending.
highlights: SK Hynix fell more than 10% while Samsung Electronics dropped 8.73%
Treasury yields above 5% spurred a tech sell‑off, with the Nasdaq Composite down 1.88%

cnbc.com/2026/10/15/elon-musk-starlink-u.headline: Musk Blames Trump for Any Limits on Ukraine's Starshield Network
cnbc.com/2026/10/15/elon-musk-starlink-u.summary: Elon Musk said the U.S. government and President Trump decide any speed or usage restrictions on Ukraine's military-grade Starshield satellite system.
highlights: Starshield is owned by the U.S. government and controlled by the U.S. military.
SpaceX imposed a speed limit on moving Starlink terminals, affecting Starshield operations for Ukrainian defense.
Speed restrictions were partially lifted, restoring connectivity up to 160 km/h after Ukrainian officials thanked Musk.

cnbc.com/2026/10/15/oil-prices-today-bre.headline: Oil Prices Slip Amid Strait of Hormuz Attack and IEA Outlook
cnbc.com/2026/10/15/oil-prices-today-bre.summary: Brent fell to $104.31 and WTI to $94.05 as traders weighed ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and the IEA’s warning of diesel market constraints.
highlights: Brent futures dropped 1.66% to $104.31 per barrel
A Singapore‑registered vessel was sunk in the Strait of Hormuz, raising supply‑disruption fears
IEA cautioned diesel market constraints could persist into next year

govt_forms_8_member_committee_to_improve.headline: Bangladesh Forms Eight‑Member Committee to Boost Airport Security
govt_forms_8_member_committee_to_improve.summary: The government appointed Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed to lead an eight‑member panel tasked with recommending airport security enhancements within two months.
highlights: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed serves as convener of the committee
Members include the civil aviation minister, chief of air staff, police inspector general and other senior officials
The panel must submit its recommendations within the next two months

parliament_forms_committee_to_review_e_p.headline: Parliament Forms 10‑Member Committee to Advance e‑Parliament Project
parliament_forms_committee_to_review_e_p.summary: Bangladesh Parliament has appointed a 10‑member committee, led by Deputy Speaker Kayser Kamal, to review the UNDP‑backed e‑Parliament Development Project Proposal.
highlights: Committee will assess the Development Project Proposal and recommend implementation measures
Director General (B&I&T) serves as committee secretary and may co‑opt additional members

govt_launches_automated_system_for_docto.headline: Bangladesh Government Deploys Automated System for Doctors' Transfers and Postings
govt_launches_automated_system_for_docto.summary: The health ministry launched software that assigns doctors based on BCS merit rankings, assessment scores and workplace preferences, aiming to curb politicisation and corruption.
highlights: Posting orders were issued for 87 doctors on the first day of the rollout
The system initially covers junior‑consultant level doctors, with phased expansion planned

treasury_yields_5pct_deficit_2tr.headline: US Treasury Yields Top 5% Amid $2 Trillion Deficit Challenge
treasury_yields_5pct_deficit_2tr.summary: Rising 10‑year Treasury yields above 5% and a $2 trillion deficit are tightening credit, slowing housing and raising concerns of a future debt crisis.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield reached 5.19% after climbing 123 basis points since February
Pending home sales fell 4% in September, the biggest monthly drop in three years
CBO estimates a $2 trillion deficit equals 6.0‑6.2% of GDP for 2026

rare_earths_eu_exports.headline: China vows continued rare earth exports to EU despite US deal expiry
rare_earths_eu_exports.summary: China's Commerce Ministry says it will keep approving rare earth licenses for Europe even if the U.S. trade agreement with Beijing lapses in January.
highlights: China will maintain rare earth shipments to the EU regardless of the U.S. trade deal status
Beijing offers a “green channel” mechanism to ensure supply while seeking EU support for Chinese dual‑use imports
European trade commissioner Maroš Sefčovič met Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao, easing recent EU‑China tensions

uk_gdp_aug_0_1.headline: UK GDP rises 0.1% in August, beating forecasts
uk_gdp_aug_0_1.summary: The UK economy grew 0.1% in August, driven by a 0.8% rise in production, surpassing expectations despite stagnant services and a dip in construction.
highlights: Annual GDP growth hit 2.1%, the strongest since August 2022.
The pound rose 0.4% versus the U.S. dollar and 10‑year gilt yields fell 9 basis points.

malaysia_hiring_bd_workers.headline: Malaysia to Recruit 10,000 Bangladeshi Workers via 338 Approved Agencies
malaysia_hiring_bd_workers.summary: Malaysia has agreed in principle to hire 10,000 Bangladeshi workers at no cost, approving 338 agencies to manage recruitment and related administrative procedures.
highlights: BOESL and 25 service agencies will handle visa and administrative processing.
Bangladesh and Malaysia are finalising the list of approved medical centres for health examinations.

q3_profit_up.headline: Uttara Bank Q3 Profit Inches Up, EPS Reaches Tk1.33
q3_profit_up.summary: Uttara Bank reported a modest rise in Q3 FY26 net profit to Tk161.32 crore, lifting standalone EPS to Tk1.33 and consolidating earnings growth.
highlights: Consolidated net profit increased to Tk159.88 crore, up from Tk158.46 crore year‑over‑year.
Operating cash flow per share surged to Tk17.02 for Jan‑Sept 2026, versus Tk0.44 last year.

suspend_tenders_procurement.headline: Bangladesh Suspends All Government Tenders Pending New Procurement Rules
suspend_tenders_procurement.summary: The Local Government Division has halted all work‑related tenders and procurement until revised rules and a new rate schedule under the 2026 amendment are issued.
highlights: All new and ongoing tenders for works, services, and goods are suspended
Exception applies only to matters of urgent national importance
The suspension remains in force until further instructions after rule finalisation

producer_price_index_september_2026.headline: U.S. Wholesale Prices Surge 6.3% Annually, Biggest Rise Since 2022
producer_price_index_september_2026.summary: September's producer price index jumped 6.3% year‑over‑year, driven by soaring energy costs amid the Iran conflict, signaling persistent inflation pressure.
highlights: PPI rose 1.3% month‑over‑month, the largest since March 2022
Core PPI increased 0.7% monthly and 5% annually, excluding food and energy
Fed funds futures now price a ~34% chance of a rate hike on Oct. 28

ai_driven_capacity_constraints_october_2.headline: TSMC Faces Fierce AI Chip Capacity Crunch Amid Record Quarter
ai_driven_capacity_constraints_october_2.summary: TSMC's record profit highlights soaring AI demand, but limited wafer capacity forces customers like Nvidia and Apple to vie for scarce advanced chips.
highlights: TSMC expects fourth‑quarter revenue to rise 58% year‑over‑year.
New fabs in Taiwan, Japan, Arizona and a potential Texas site aim to add $265 billion of capacity.

jio_platforms_ipo_announcement_october_2.headline: Meta and Google-backed Jio Platforms targets $3.2 billion historic IPO
jio_platforms_ipo_announcement_october_2.summary: Jio Platforms aims to raise up to 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in India's largest rupee‑denominated IPO, backed by Reliance, Meta and Google.
highlights: The IPO will sell 270 million shares priced between 1,065 and 1,119 rupees each.
At the top price range, Jio Platforms would be valued around $108 billion, below rival Bharti Airtel’s $117.5 billion market cap.
Meta and Google will retain their stakes and not sell shares in the offering.

fiscal_year_shift.headline: Bangladesh Moves Fiscal Year to April‑March, Ministries Given Tight Deadline
fiscal_year_shift.summary: The government has ordered all ministries to submit time‑bound plans by 25 October to amend laws, regulations and systems for shifting the fiscal year to April‑March.
highlights: Cabinet decided to shift the fiscal year from July‑June to April‑March, setting FY2027‑28 as a nine‑month transition period.
Ministries must submit amendment plans by 25 October covering laws, SROs, contracts and IT systems.

power_purchase_policy.headline: Bangladesh Halts New Power Purchases Above Average Tariff to Cut Subsidies
power_purchase_policy.summary: The government will stop signing new power purchase agreements at rates higher than the average tariff, aiming to reduce the Tk4.30 per unit subsidy burden.
highlights: Current BPDB purchases average Tk12.80/kWh and sells at Tk8.50/kWh, creating a Tk4.30 subsidy per unit.
The policy also prevents extensions of existing contracts with rates above the average tariff.

nagad_no_sale_plan.headline: Bangladesh Government Rejects Sale of Nagad, Aims to Modernise Postal Services
nagad_no_sale_plan.summary: Minister Faqir Mahbub Anam affirmed no immediate plan to divest Nagad, while pledging reforms to transform the postal department into a modern, profitable public service.
highlights: Government will leverage the extensive nationwide post office network to expand technology‑based services and franchise operations
Foreign investors have shown interest in the postal department’s modernization

hot_ppi_shows_fed_s_work_is_not_done.headline: Hot PPI Signals Fed May Need Further Rate Hikes
hot_ppi_shows_fed_s_work_is_not_done.summary: A 1.3% rise in the producer price index, the strongest since March 2022, suggests inflation remains broad and could prompt additional Fed rate hikes.
highlights: PPI jumped 1.3% month‑over‑month, the biggest gain since March 2022
Core PCE inflation for September is forecast to rise to 0.32%, pushing annual core inflation to 3.1%
Fed futures show a 91% chance of at least one rate hike by December

treasury_yields_slide_as_investors_flee_.headline: Treasury Yields Slip as Tech Sell‑off Drives Investors to Safe Bonds
treasury_yields_slide_as_investors_flee_.summary: U.S. Treasury yields fell sharply after wholesale inflation surged to 6.3%, prompting a tech rout and a flight to safety in government bonds.
highlights: 10‑year yield dropped to 5.089%, down over 10 basis points
30‑year yield fell to 5.428%, down more than 9 basis points
Fed funds futures now price another quarter‑point rate hike by year‑end

u_s_treasury_dismisses_imf_debt_warning_.headline: Treasury Pushes Back on IMF Debt Warning, Calls Forecasts Messy
u_s_treasury_dismisses_imf_debt_warning_.summary: U.S. Treasury counselor David Zervos dismissed IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva’s debt sustainability warning, citing the fund’s historically inaccurate growth forecasts.
highlights: Zervos criticized IMF’s past forecasts, referencing errors in the 1997 Asian crisis, the 2008 World Economic Outlook, and
IMF warned that strong U.S. growth may not curb the $40 trillion debt trajectory
Institute of International Finance warned global debt service costs rising, with total debt at $365 trillion

tbsnews.net/economy/aviation/investment-.headline: Foreign Ground‑Handling Firms Offer $12m‑Plus Investment and 1,500 Jobs for Bangladesh Airport
tbsnews.net/economy/aviation/investment-.summary: Bangladesh’s CAAB seeks genuine equity partnerships as four global ground‑handling giants propose multi‑million‑dollar investments and thousands of local jobs for the third terminal.
highlights: Menzies pledged $12 million investment and over 1,000 direct jobs
Çelebi aims to invest above Menzies’ benchmark and create up to 1,500 local positions

tbsnews.net/economy/energy/long-term-lng.headline: OQT's Spot-Linked LNG Pricing Threatens Bangladesh Supply Contract
tbsnews.net/economy/energy/long-term-lng.summary: Bangladesh's RPGCL rejected OQT's proposal to switch to a Japan‑Korea Marker price, warning the new formula could nearly double LNG costs and breach existing contracts.
highlights: OQT offered to deliver only 16 of the 32 cargoes scheduled for 2027.
The JKM‑linked price would be $26.235 per MMBtu, about 99% higher than the first contract price.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/law-order/masterm.headline: Investigation Continues as Masterminds Behind Radda Attack Remain at Large
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/law-order/masterm.summary: Police have arrested 25 suspects but still lack evidence to identify the political figures who allegedly orchestrated the September 25 Radda centre raid.
highlights: Over 200 masked individuals looted medical supplies and used an excavator to demolish buildings.
Former MP Ferdousi Ahmed Mishti stepped down amid allegations, while investigations focus on CCTV evidence.

fed_warsh_no_signal.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Declines Forward Guidance Amid Global Rate Tightening
fed_warsh_no_signal.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh avoided signaling future hikes, noting a synchronous tightening by central banks worldwide while the Fed’s policy sits at 3.75%‑4% range.
highlights: Warsh said the Fed will not use forward guidance and will let data drive decisions
He highlighted a global "synchronous tightening" of monetary policy with no free riders
Traders assign a 72.3% chance the Fed will hold rates steady at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting

rupee_weakening_forecast.headline: India's Rupee May Near 100 per Dollar Despite RBI Interventions
rupee_weakening_forecast.summary: Fund outflows, high oil prices and a widening current‑account deficit could push the rupee toward the 100‑per‑dollar level even as the RBI tightens policy.
highlights: RBI's new measures make speculative bets on the rupee more expensive and restrict rebooking of cancelled FX derivative contracts
Foreign exchange reserves fell by $51 billion after aggressive spot‑market interventions

strait_of_hormuz_attacks.headline: Singapore Ships Attacked Yet Others Still Brave Strait of Hormuz
strait_of_hormuz_attacks.summary: Despite recent attacks on two Singapore‑flagged vessels, strong oil demand and profitable Hormuz shuttle operations keep many tankers and regional ships transiting the strategic chokepoint.
highlights: Crossings fell to 131 vessels in the week ending Oct. 14, down from 176 the prior week.
GFS Pride sank after being struck by a projectile, while GFS Giselle was damaged but crew survived.
Operators run self‑insured "Hormuz shuttle" trips with very large crude carriers, citing higher oil prices as justification.

imf_bangladesh_meeting_2026_10_17.headline: IMF chief warns of inflation and debt risks for low‑income nations amid AI optimism
imf_bangladesh_meeting_2026_10_17.summary: At the Bangkok Annual Meetings, IMF head Kristalina Georgieva highlighted rising inflation, soaring bond yields and debt burdens threatening growth in low‑income countries.
highlights: Global inflation surged after the US‑Israel war on Iran, pushing bond yields higher.
Debt repayments now consume up to 14% of government revenue in low‑income nations.
AI investment drives growth in advanced economies but raises regulatory concerns.

bangladesh_japan_investment_2026_10_17.headline: Bangladesh pitches $14 billion Japan investment package across transport, energy, tech
bangladesh_japan_investment_2026_10_17.summary: Bangladesh will seek ¥2.2 trillion in concessional loans, private capital and PPPs to boost transport, energy, manufacturing and skilled‑worker exchanges with Japan.
highlights: The proposal allocates ¥550 billion for metro rail expansion, major bridges and the Chattogram‑Matarbari‑Cox's Bazar corridor.
Bangladesh aims to send 100,000 skilled workers and students to Japan each year, supported by a new Human Resource Development
A ¥25 billion PPP Project Preparation Facility will be created to attract private Japanese investors to the Bay of Bengal

dse_turnover_lowest_2026_10_17.headline: DSE Turnover Plummets to Nine-Month Low Amid Weak Trading
dse_turnover_lowest_2026_10_17.summary: Turnover on the Dhaka Stock Exchange fell 36% to Tk317 crore, the lowest since December 2025, as the DSEX index slipped 0.35%.
highlights: Turnover dropped to Tk317 crore, a 36% decline from the previous session
DSEX index closed at 5,433 points, down 0.35%
Most sectors posted negative returns, with mutual funds and jute seeing the steepest drops

brent_oil_touches_110_as_iran_escalates_.headline: Brent Hits $110 as Iran Escalates Hormuz Attacks and Ukraine Targets Russian Refineries
brent_oil_touches_110_as_iran_escalates_.summary: Brent rose to $110 per barrel amid intensified Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and renewed Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, pushing oil markets higher.
highlights: Brent futures reached $110, first since May, closing at $109.86, up 3.7%
U.S. crude inventories fell over 8 million barrels for the week due to Gulf Coast production shut‑ins from Hurricane Isaias
Oil exports through Hormuz dropped to 9.4 million barrels per day, about 70% of pre‑war levels

u_s_budget_deficit_swells_to_almost_2_tr.headline: U.S. Deficit Near $2 Trillion in FY2026, Up 12% YoY
u_s_budget_deficit_swells_to_almost_2_tr.summary: The Treasury reported a $1.992 trillion deficit for fiscal 2026, a 12% rise and the third‑largest ever, driven by soaring Social Security and interest costs.
highlights: Deficit reached $1.992 trillion, 12% higher than FY2025
Social Security spending hit $1.7 trillion, the largest share of outlays
Net interest exceeded $1 trillion as total debt passed $40 trillion

bending_spoons_wants_to_revive_software_.headline: Berkshire backs Bending Spoons as it revives AI‑era SaaS castoffs
bending_spoons_wants_to_revive_software_.summary: Bending Spoons, backed by a $900 million Berkshire investment, is buying undervalued SaaS firms like Airtable and Miro, while cutting jobs to reshape the AI‑driven software market.
highlights: Berkshire Hathaway invested $330 million for a stake, bringing total investment to over $900 million.
Bending Spoons acquired Airtable for $1.3 billion, about 90% below its 2021 peak valuation.
The company's market cap rose to roughly $30 billion after the deal.

bsec_fine_lovello.headline: BSEC fines CBC Capital syndicate Tk35.92 lakh for Lovello share manipulation
bsec_fine_lovello.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission imposed a Tk35.92 lakh fine on CBC Capital and affiliates for series trading that lifted Lovello Ice‑Cream shares by 25%.
highlights: The investigation uncovered 13 matched circular transactions involving 967,125 shares, accounting for 22.30% of Lovello’s
Penalties ranged from Tk2 lakh to Tk14.66 lakh, with the corporate provident fund receiving the highest fine.
Regulators cited violations of the Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969, imposing a Tk1 lakh base fine for each matched trade.

guidelines_commercialise_state_assets.headline: Invest Bangladesh Finalises Guidelines to Commercialise Idle State Assets
guidelines_commercialise_state_assets.summary: Invest Bangladesh is set to issue final guidelines that will enable the transfer and divestiture of loss‑making state‑owned enterprises and unused land to attract investment and create jobs.
highlights: The draft, titled Policy on the Transfer of State‑Owned Industrial or Commercial Enterprises, was reviewed at the Prime
44 identified state‑owned enterprises will be offered through public‑private partnerships, joint ventures, long‑term leases or

single_portal_trade_licences.headline: Bangladesh to Launch Single Online Portal for Trade Licences
single_portal_trade_licences.summary: The government will create a unified digital portal and coordinated inspection system to cut administrative delays, costs and harassment for businesses.
highlights: Trade licences will be issued online, replacing separate local authority processes
A coordinated inspection system led by Invest Bangladesh Authority will consolidate building, fire and environmental checks
The task force will consider extending licence validity and introducing a business registration certificate

graham_act_waiver.headline: Trump Waives Key Tariffs in Graham Act Amid Election Pressure
graham_act_waiver.summary: President Trump issued a waiver exempting Russian imports from the 500% duty and 100% tariffs on top oil buyers, citing national interest before the act’s deadline.
highlights: The waiver preserves earlier sanctions on Russia while suspending the new duties and tariffs.
The move follows a temporary diesel export waiver and comes weeks before the November midterm elections.

semiconductor_demand_supply_gap.headline: South Korea Finance Minister Says Semiconductor Boom Will Last Through 2027
semiconductor_demand_supply_gap.summary: South Korean finance minister Lee Hyoung-Il predicts the semiconductor boom will continue at least until 2027, despite recent stock sell‑offs and AI slowdown concerns.
highlights: Lee highlighted a wide demand‑supply gap and ongoing expansion of semiconductor production
Recent sell‑offs hit SK Hynix, Seoul Semiconductor and Nvidia amid interest‑rate and competition worries
The chip surge is boosting South Korea’s tax revenue and strengthening its fiscal position

ai_stock_selloff.headline: AI Stock Plunge Meets Rising Inflation as Markets Seek Diversification
ai_stock_selloff.summary: Higher consumer inflation and hotter oil prices sparked a sharp sell‑off in AI‑heavy stocks, while banks posted solid earnings and defensive sectors drew investor interest.
highlights: Nasdaq fell 4.5% weekly, its worst decline since June, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.7%.
September CPI rose 3.7% YoY, above expectations, and producer prices jumped 1.3% month‑over‑month.
CoreWeave’s debt topped $51 billion, its shares dropped 25%, and cyber stocks Palo Alto Networks and CrowdStrike fell over 17%.

renata_profit_jumps_64_on_operational_ma.headline: Renata profit surges 64% as efficiencies cut costs
renata_profit_jumps_64_on_operational_ma.summary: Renata posted a 64% profit jump to Tk364 crore in FY26, driven by operational efficiencies, lower financing costs and strong volume‑driven sales.
highlights: Revenue grew only 7.7% to Tk4,620 crore while profit rose 64%
Dividend recommendation unchanged at 55% cash (Tk5.50 per share)
Debt reduced by Tk459 crore, net debt now Tk1,429 crore

pm_urges_youths_to_put_bangladesh_first_.institution: Government of Bangladesh / Ministry of Youth and Sports
pm_urges_youths_to_put_bangladesh_first_.headline: PM Announces Tk 500 crore Startup Fund, Calls Youth to Prioritize Bangladesh
pm_urges_youths_to_put_bangladesh_first_.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman urged young Bangladeshis to put national interests first and unveiled a Tk 500 crore fund to boost youth startups.
highlights: Youth Volunteer Award 2026 presented to 15 volunteers, each receiving a Tk 1 lakh cheque
Grants of Tk 2 lakh allocated to 432 youth organisations across all 64 districts

wage_board_for_garment_workers_soon_labo.headline: Bangladesh to Form Wage Board for RMG Workers Soon
highlights: Nominations from workers and employers are being collected for board membership
The board will include a chairman, an independent member, and sector-specific representatives for both sides
Gazette notification expected by end of October

berkshire_shares_buck_market_sell_off_ra.headline: Berkshire Shares Surge to Highest Since Buffett’s CEO Exit Announcement
berkshire_shares_buck_market_sell_off_ra.summary: Berkshire Hathaway’s Class A and B stocks rose to near‑record levels, buoyed by cash‑rich buybacks, higher interest earnings and new tech investment.
highlights: BRK.A closed at $798,000, just 1.4% below its all‑time high.
Berkshire repurchased $4.5 billion of shares in Q2 and invested $330 million in Bending Spoons.
Higher rates and a quiet hurricane season boosted earnings from its $360 billion cash pile and insurance operations.

trump_s_russia_diesel_deal_may_offer_put.headline: Trump's Diesel Deal with Russia Raises Stakes for Ukraine and Western Unity
trump_s_russia_diesel_deal_may_offer_put.summary: Trump's agreement to ease sanctions for Russian diesel exports offers Moscow political leverage while deepening Ukraine's security doubts ahead of winter.
highlights: Russia will ship 4.8 million metric tons of diesel, roughly ten days of U.S. demand.
The deal could generate up to $1.25 billion in export revenue but adds less than $30 million monthly to Russia's budget.
U.S. intelligence sharing with Ukraine has been restricted, hampering drone defense capabilities.

dead_money_for_a_decade_why_this_hedge_f.headline: Managed Futures ETFs Challenge Dead Money Bonds in 60/40 Portfolios
dead_money_for_a_decade_why_this_hedge_f.summary: Andrew Beer argues that managed futures ETFs offer a low‑correlation, crisis‑ready alternative to bonds, potentially boosting returns while diversifying traditional 60/40 allocations.
highlights: DBMF ETF has gained nearly 19% year‑to‑date.
Managed futures can go long and short across global markets, providing low correlation to stocks and bonds.

tourism_investment_1_2b.headline: Japanese Investors Commit $1.2 Billion to Boost Bangladesh Tourism
tourism_investment_1_2b.summary: Japan's delegation will invest $1.2 billion in Bangladesh's tourism and hospitality, aiming to develop sites like the Sundarbans, Cox's Bazar and Sylhet tea gardens.
highlights: Investment will be structured through public‑private partnerships
Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat affirmed government readiness to facilitate swift measures

fta_discussion_bangladesh_uzbekistan.headline: Bangladesh and Uzbekistan Explore Free Trade Agreement to Boost Bilateral Trade and Investment
fta_discussion_bangladesh_uzbekistan.summary: Bangladesh’s state minister met Uzbekistan’s deputy foreign minister in Baghdad to discuss a potential free trade pact aimed at expanding trade, investment, and connectivity.
highlights: Both sides examined cooperation in trade, investment, air connectivity, and tourism
Discussions took place on the sidelines of the 52nd OIC Council of Foreign Ministers in Baghdad

duty_evasion_concealment_7_5cr.headline: Customs Uncover Tk7.5 crore Duty Evasion via Misdeclared Imports
duty_evasion_concealment_7_5cr.summary: Intelligence-led inspections at Chattogram port revealed cosmetics, automotive parts and industrial goods concealed under false declarations, costing the treasury roughly Tk7.5 crore.
highlights: Eight cases involved high‑duty items like branded cosmetics and car components hidden behind low‑duty entries
Fraud included replacing customs seals on a locked container and misusing HS codes
Estimated revenue losses ranged from Tk40 lakh to Tk2.8 crore per shipment

hedge_fund_driven_bond_market_shock_risk.headline: Hedge Funds Heighten Risk of Global Bond Market Shock
hedge_fund_driven_bond_market_shock_risk.summary: Bank of England deputy governor warns that hedge funds’ leveraged, price‑sensitive activity in government bonds raises the chance of localized turbulence spreading into a broader financial shock.
highlights: Hedge funds hold a record 7% of the $30 trillion Treasury market as of end‑2025
Their leveraged basis trades amplify price gaps and can turbo‑charge market stress
The IMF reports hedge fund assets near $13 trillion and cautions about crowded trades

us_timberland_acquisition_boom.headline: Investors Turn to Timberland as Long‑Term Real Asset Amid Housing Slump
us_timberland_acquisition_boom.summary: Institutional and younger investors are buying U.S. timberland at about one million acres annually, seeking low‑return, long‑term diversification despite market conditions.
highlights: Institutions purchase roughly one million acres of timberland each year, with managers acquiring 55% of all transactions in 2025.
Timber prices are mixed: pine pulpwood stumpage fell 33% in 2026, while hardwood sawtimber rose 40%.
Timber ETFs like WOOD and CUT provide liquid exposure but do not own trees directly.

student_loan_overhaul_bankruptcy_impact.headline: Trump Student Loan Bill May Spur Surge in Bankruptcy Filings
student_loan_overhaul_bankruptcy_impact.summary: A new Trump-backed loan cap law could push borrowers into bankruptcy as higher rates make repayment unsustainable, according to former bankruptcy judge.
highlights: The 2025 bill imposes federal loan caps, driving private loans to interest rates up to 16%
Bankruptcy filings rose 50% since 2022, exceeding half a million cases in 2025
Strict bankruptcy rules still prevent most student loans from being discharged

bepza_investment_per_acre.headline: Bepza Secures $3 Million per Acre, Boosts Exports to $8.41 Billion
bepza_investment_per_acre.summary: Bepza attracted roughly $3 million per acre, generating Tk13.82 crore annually while zone exports rose 2.22% to $8.41 billion in FY26.
highlights: Signed investment agreements with 36 companies in FY26.
Bepza’s zones account for 20% of Bangladesh’s total exports and 19.17% of FDI.

secretariat_relocation_2029.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Approves Secretariat Relocation to Sher‑e‑Bangla Nagar by 2029
secretariat_relocation_2029.summary: The government will move the Bangladesh Secretariat from Abdul Gani Road to a new complex at Sher‑e‑Bangla Nagar, with operations starting in 2029.
highlights: Cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman approved the move
Ministry of Housing and Public Works will include the project in the Annual Development Programme

garment_worker_death.headline: Garment Worker Dies After Confrontation at Ashulia Factory, Supervisor Suspended
garment_worker_death.summary: A 26‑year‑old sewing operator collapsed and died after a violent confrontation at Agami Apparels in Ashulia, prompting a supervisor suspension.
highlights: CCTV captured a man assaulting the worker’s sewing machine before she fell
Company issued a show‑cause notice and temporarily suspended the line supervisor
Police sent the body for autopsy while the husband filed a legal complaint

iran_new_operational_plan_shipping.headline: Iran Threatens New Operational Plan Amid Rising Gulf Shipping Attacks
iran_new_operational_plan_shipping.summary: Iran announced a more aggressive response strategy as multiple commercial vessels were struck near the Arabian Peninsula, raising regional security and oil price concerns.
highlights: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported a tug hit by two projectiles near the United Arab Emirates
An LNG tanker off Yemen was approached by a skiff that fired twice, prompting warning shots
Brent crude futures rose to $110 per barrel, a 3.7% gain, amid the tensions

roth_conversion_tax_implications.headline: Roth Conversions Surge 41% Amid Tax Bracket Complexities
roth_conversion_tax_implications.summary: Roth IRA conversions rose 41% in 2025, but advisors warn higher tax brackets and ACA eligibility limits can make the move costly for many retirees.
highlights: Traditional IRA assets reached $15.9 trillion versus $2.4 trillion in Roth IRAs in 2025
Fidelity data shows conversions up 41% year‑over‑year
Conversion income can push taxpayers into a >30% bracket, affecting education credits and ACA premium subsidies

analysts_bullish_three_stocks.headline: Wall Street Analysts Bullish on UnitedHealth, Meta, and Marvell Stocks
analysts_bullish_three_stocks.summary: Despite AI trade tensions and oil price pressures, top analysts recommend UnitedHealth, Meta Platforms, and Marvell as high‑growth picks for long‑term investors.
highlights: UnitedHealth raised its 2026 EPS outlook to at least $20.50 and targets $23.17 EPS by 2027.
Meta’s Muse AI agent reached 1.3 million daily active users in five weeks, still under 0.05% of its 3.6 billion base.
Marvell expanded its total addressable market to $400 billion by 2030 and set a FY31 revenue goal of $30 billion.

draft_special_solar_power_installation_o.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Approves Ordinance to Accelerate Rooftop Solar Installations
draft_special_solar_power_installation_o.summary: The cabinet gave final approval to a draft ordinance that creates a regulatory framework for rooftop solar projects, aiming to cut fossil fuel imports and subsidies.
highlights: Government targets 3,000‑4,000 MW of rooftop solar by next summer
Installations will use OPEX financing for public institutions and CAPEX options for revenue‑generating entities
Draft ordinance fills gaps in pricing, rent‑share and procurement rules

unlicensed_payment_platforms_flagged_22.headline: Bangladesh Bank flags 22 unlicensed payment platforms over fraud risks
unlicensed_payment_platforms_flagged_22.summary: Bangladesh Bank warned that unlicensed loan and payment apps steal personal data, expose borrowers to blackmail, and violate the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
highlights: 22 platforms, including BohudurPay and ZiniPay, operate without Bangladesh Bank licences
Violations breach Section 15(2) and Section 37(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2024

bank_share_price_upside_recommendations.headline: CAL Bangladesh Picks Five Banks with Up to 81% Share Upside
bank_share_price_upside_recommendations.summary: CAL Bangladesh recommends BRAC Bank, City Bank, Eastern Bank, Dutch‑Bangla Bank and Pubali Bank, forecasting up to 81% price gains as sector reforms boost credit expansion.
highlights: BRAC Bank target price Tk117.45 implies 80.7% upside
Median NPL ratio of Cycle‑Ready banks is 3.8% versus sector 32.8%
Regulatory cap limits weighted‑average lending‑deposit spreads to 4%

starlink_restriction_warning.headline: Bessent cautions Zelenskyy on claims of U.S. Starlink slowdown
starlink_restriction_warning.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned President Zelenskyy to avoid unverified accusations that the United States is throttling the military Starlink service, Starshield, amid ongoing restrictions.
highlights: Starshield, the government‑controlled version of SpaceX’s Starlink, has faced speed limits imposed by the U.S. military.
President Trump denied any involvement in the slowdown, despite White House orders reportedly restricting the technology.
U.S. lawmakers criticized Trump’s waiver of sanctions while he promoted importing Russian diesel to lower fuel prices.

weekly_stock_market_preview.headline: Earnings Week Ahead: Capital One, Meta, and AI Chip Makers in Focus
weekly_stock_market_preview.summary: This week’s earnings season spotlights Capital One’s credit outlook, Meta’s AI-driven growth, and key semiconductor reports amid rising bond yields and inflation pressures.
highlights: Capital One expected EPS $5.50 on $16.26 billion revenue, with focus on net interest margin and charge‑offs.
Meta projected EPS $5.94 on $63.32 billion revenue, emphasizing AI platform Muse and user engagement metrics.
Semiconductor makers Lam Research and Texas Instruments report, offering insight into AI buildout and supply‑demand balance.

bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.institution: Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment
bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.headline: Bangladesh and Japan Sign Employment Skills Deal, Recruitment Starts 2027
bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.summary: The new Memorandum of Cooperation on Employment Skills Development will allow Bangladeshi workers to be recruited to Japan from April 2027, offering legal protection and skill‑building opportunities.
highlights: Recruitment of Bangladeshi workers to Japan begins on 1 April 2027 under a ten‑year agreement.
The deal guarantees equal legal protection for Bangladeshi migrants, including safeguards against gender‑based dismissal.
The agreement was signed by Bangladesh’s Ministry of Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment and multiple Japanese

dsex_edges_down_as_sell_off_continues_fo.headline: DSEX slips as sell‑off persists into second session
dsex_edges_down_as_sell_off_continues_fo.summary: The DSEX fell to 5,422 as turnover dropped to Tk365 crore, with investors cautious amid earnings disclosures and technical disruptions on the DSE.
highlights: Blue‑chip DS30 index slipped 4 points to 2,085
Textiles led turnover with a 23% share

bsec_closes_proceedings_against_investor.headline: BSEC Drops Enforcement Case Against Investor Zhuang Lifefeng
bsec_closes_proceedings_against_investor.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission dismissed proceedings against investor Zhuang Lifeng, while simultaneously fining CBC Capital and related parties for series trading and price manipulation.
highlights: Zhuang held a Beneficiary Owner account with Prime Bank Securities and appeared at a hearing on 20 April.
CBC Capital and affiliates were fined a total of Tk35.92 lakh for manipulating shares of Taufika Foods and Lovello Ice‑Cream PLC.

india_s_finance_minister_says_easy_exits.headline: India Finance Minister Blames Easy Liquidity for Equity Market Underperformance
india_s_finance_minister_says_easy_exits.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman warned that abundant liquidity and easy exits are driving a near‑12% slump in Indian equities despite solid economic fundamentals.
highlights: Benchmark indexes have fallen almost 12% since January, per LSEG data.
Foreign investors have sold over $33 billion of direct Indian equities this year.
Domestic mutual funds have logged net inflows every month since March 2021.

indonesian_stocks_plunge_to_six_year_low.headline: Indonesian Stocks Plunge Over 5% Amid MSCI Downgrade Fears
indonesian_stocks_plunge_to_six_year_low.summary: Indonesia's benchmark index fell to a six‑year low as MSCI's possible reclassification sparks fears of $5.6 billion passive fund outflows and further foreign investor withdrawals.
highlights: MSCI may move Indonesia from emerging‑market to stand‑alone status, with a final decision due by June.
Goldman Sachs estimates up to $5.6 billion could exit passive funds if MSCI removes Indonesia, with an additional $2.7 billion
Foreign ownership of Indonesian equities fell to 25% in October, down from 27% in January, halving the value of holdings to

france_hit_by_worst_unrest_in_years_as_a.headline: France Faces Violent Unrest Over Budget Cuts and Rising Living Costs
france_hit_by_worst_unrest_in_years_as_a.summary: Mass protests erupted across France as the government seeks €54 billion in savings, sparking riots, arrests and a deadly clash over high living costs.
highlights: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested and about 1,000 police injured.
The budget aims to trim €54 billion to reduce a debt of €3.6 trillion, 119% of GDP.

energy_crisis_cushion.headline: Bangladesh Finance Minister Seeks Two-Year Cushion to Tackle Energy Crisis
energy_crisis_cushion.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury requested a two‑year buffer to address the gas shortage, expand LNG infrastructure and stabilize the economy amid global fallout.
highlights: Bangladesh has incurred $7 billion in out‑of‑pocket energy costs and plans to drill 150 wells through state‑owned Bapex.
The government aims to add 10 GW of solar capacity and develop three to four floating storage and regasification units within

middle_east_energy_costs.headline: Middle East Crisis Adds $4.12 Billion to Bangladesh Energy Costs, Gov't Pushes Matarbari Hub
middle_east_energy_costs.summary: The ongoing Middle East crisis has raised Bangladesh’s energy expenses by $4.12 billion in eight months, while officials promote a new regional hub.
highlights: Energy sector faces $4.12 billion added cost over eight months due to Middle East tensions
Government aims to develop Matarbari into a regional energy hub
BGMEA launches ESG platform to boost garment export competitiveness

interim_dividend.headline: LafargeHolcim Announces 10% Interim Dividend Amid Profit Decline
interim_dividend.summary: LafargeHolcim Bangladesh posted a 21% drop in net profit for the first nine months despite a 6% sales rise, yet declared a 10% interim cash dividend.
highlights: Operating EBIT fell 19% year‑on‑year to Tk349 crore.
Geocycle co‑processed over 31,000 tonnes of waste, achieving a 10% fossil fuel replacement rate.

yen_interest_rate.headline: Japan PM Takaichi Defends Yen Policy Amid Rising Bond Yields
yen_interest_rate.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi rejected criticism linking her to the weak yen and higher interest rates, pledging to boost confidence while managing government bond issuance.
highlights: Yields on Japanese government bonds have reached multi‑decade highs as the central bank raises policy rates.
The yen fell to its lowest level since 1986, prompting intervention from Tokyo and Washington.

public_benefit_fund.headline: Anthropic Allocates 5% Shares to New AI Job‑Disruption Fund
public_benefit_fund.summary: Anthropic will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit LLC, with potential increases tied to valuation growth, to address AI‑driven job disruption.
highlights: Fund initially holds 5% of Anthropic shares and may rise by 2% for each 50% valuation increase.
Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion ahead of a planned November IPO.
The fund is structured as an LLC, not a 501(c)(3), and equity will not be used for lobbying.

data_center_energy.headline: Google Partners with Xcel Energy to Finance Cleaner AI Data Center
data_center_energy.summary: Google will fund 1,400 MW of wind, 200 MW of solar and 300 MW of battery storage for Xcel’s grid, powering its 780‑MW AI data center with carbon‑free energy by 2030.
highlights: Google commits to pay at least 75% of contracted capacity even if it uses less
The agreement adds more renewable capacity than the data center’s consumption, benefiting all local Xcel customers
Approval pending from the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission

direct_listing_rules.headline: BSEC Tightens Direct Listing Rules, Extends Price Discovery to Two Hours
direct_listing_rules.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission raised turnover thresholds, set minimum asking prices 25% below reference, and extended first‑day price discovery to two hours.
highlights: Minimum net worth for banks, financial institutions and insurers increased to Tk500 crore.
Annual turnover requirement for large firms raised to Tk1,000 crore and commercial operation period extended to five years.
Asking price must be at least 25% below reference price and backed by two valuation methods.

commodity_derivatives_licence.headline: Bangladesh BSEC approves six brokers for commodity derivatives licence
commodity_derivatives_licence.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission gave in‑principle approval to six brokerage firms to become commodity derivatives brokers, paving the way for the country's first exchange.
highlights: The approved firms are Sohel Securities Limited, Island Securities Limited, NLI Securities Limited, Be Rich Limited, PHP Stocks
The Chittagong Stock Exchange plans to launch futures contracts for gold, silver and crude palm oil as the initial products.
The exchange will later enable farmers to hedge rice and wheat prices months before harvest.

kokil_textile_ppp.headline: Bangladesh Approves PPP Revitalization of Kokil Textile Mill in Brahmanbaria
kokil_textile_ppp.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs gave in‑principle approval to redevelop the long‑idle Kokil Textile Mills under a public‑private partnership.
highlights: The project will be implemented through Bangladesh Textile Mills Corporation (BTMC).
Previous private owners left unpaid dues of Tk 33.84 crore.

fi_2027_postponement.headline: Saudi Postpones Future Investment Initiative to 2027 Amid Houthi Attacks
fi_2027_postponement.summary: Saudi Arabia delayed its flagship Future Investment Initiative conference to 2027 after escalating Houthi missile and drone attacks threatened the safety of participants.
highlights: The original event was set for Oct. 26‑29 in Riyadh.
Prominent speakers included Jamie Dimon, David Solomon, Stephen Schwarzman, Larry Fink and Jane Fraser.
Saudi military intercepted drones and missiles targeting Riyadh and the Red Sea port of Yanbu.

fr_market_stress.headline: French Unrest Fuels Debt Crisis Fears, Markets Slide
fr_market_stress.summary: Political turmoil and rising bond yields have pushed the euro, CAC 40 and French OATs lower, intensifying concerns over France’s fiscal outlook.
highlights: 10-year OAT yield rose over 10 basis points, nearing its highest level in decades
Overseas investors now hold nearly 60% of French debt, up from 48% in 2022
The OAT‑Bund spread hit its widest since the early‑2010s sovereign debt crisis

jpm_defense_5b.headline: JPMorgan Chase Deploys $5 Billion in Defense Startup Investments
jpm_defense_5b.summary: JPMorgan Chase has poured $5 billion into early‑stage defense, manufacturing and supply‑chain startups, signaling a rapid shift toward securing U.S. strategic industries.
highlights: The bank led a $1.4 billion round for Hadrian, which operates factories with ten robots per worker.
JPMorgan backed Castelion’s low‑cost hypersonic missile “Blackbeard” in a $1 billion funding round.
The initiative aims to reach $1.5 trillion in security‑related financing over ten years.

vat_target_15_by_2030_imf_condition.headline: Bangladesh Aims for Uniform 15% VAT by 2030 to Satisfy IMF
vat_target_15_by_2030_imf_condition.summary: Bangladesh plans to phase out over 500 VAT exemptions and adopt a single 15% rate by 2030, meeting IMF loan conditions while retaining essential item exemptions.
highlights: Current VAT concessions cover more than 500 goods and services, including electronics and metro rail.
Uniform rate could raise prices on hundreds of products, though essential food and healthcare will stay exempt.

bsec_plans_unified_real_time_monitoring_.summary: BSEC’s feasibility study aims to implement a real‑time monitoring system for brokerage houses, linking bank balances, client accounts and depository records to curb embezzlement.
highlights: BSEC plans a unified back‑office platform to reconcile brokerage banks with client consolidated accounts
Six brokerage firms allegedly misappropriated Tk608 cr, prompting compensation claims exceeding Tk250 cr
Implementation challenges include high costs, data migration and cybersecurity safeguards

jobless_claims_low_1960s.headline: U.S. Jobless Claims Near Six-Decade Low as Labor Market Holds Steady
jobless_claims_low_1960s.summary: Initial unemployment filings fell to 194,000, the lowest level since the 1960s, indicating a resilient labor market despite weak hiring and modest payroll growth.
highlights: Four‑week moving average of claims dropped to 197,750.
Layoff rate fell to 1% of the workforce over the past year.

largest_wealth_fund_30b_loss.headline: Norway's Sovereign Wealth Fund Records $30 Billion Loss Amid Bond Turmoil
largest_wealth_fund_30b_loss.summary: The $2.3 trillion Norges Bank Investment Management reported a $30 billion third‑quarter loss as rising rates hurt its government‑bond holdings.
highlights: Fixed income portfolio returned –3.5%, driving overall downturn
Equities yielded only 0.5% while energy stocks outperformed

swf_china_hk_investments_190pct_jump.headline: Sovereign Wealth Funds Boost China and Hong Kong Investments by 190%
swf_china_hk_investments_190pct_jump.summary: Middle Eastern sovereign investors poured $14.2 billion into China and Hong Kong in 2026, reversing a previous year’s slump amid renewed confidence.
highlights: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund contributed $6 billion, while Abu Dhabi Investment Authority added $2.5 billion.
Gulf funds now represent nearly 70% of sovereign inflows to China and Hong Kong.
Investors target technology, biotechnology, consumer and advanced manufacturing sectors.

php_flaw_mass_outages.headline: Global PHP Flaws Trigger Millions of Hacks, Prompt Emergency Shutdowns
php_flaw_mass_outages.summary: Critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed led to millions of hacking attempts worldwide, forcing banks, airlines and governments to suspend services and rush patch deployments.
highlights: Cloudflare recorded millions of attack attempts within hours of disclosure
Japanese firms including Nomura and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group temporarily halted online services
Governments in Europe and Asia raised cybersecurity alerts and ordered inspections

php_flaw_hacking_attempts.headline: European Governments Pull Websites Offline Over Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
php_flaw_hacking_attempts.summary: Several European ministries and public institutions temporarily disabled their sites as a precaution after critical flaws were discovered in the widely used PHP programming language.
highlights: German IT service provider ITZBund and French Interior Ministry removed public sites pending patches
Dutch organizations including Port of Rotterdam and national football association KNVB preemptively shut down access
Wikimedia Foundation and Japan’s Ministry of Finance also suspended services to apply emergency security updates

dammam_riyadh_suspensions.headline: Biman Bangladesh Airlines Suspends Dhaka‑Dammam and Dhaka‑Riyadh Flights Amid Saudi Security Threats
dammam_riyadh_suspensions.summary: Biman has halted all Dhaka‑Dammam flights until 25 October and Dhaka‑Riyadh flights until 31 October after an attack on King Fahd International Airport, citing passenger safety.
highlights: Suspension covers flights scheduled for 23‑25 Oct to Dammam and all flights to Riyadh until 31 Oct
Flights to Jeddah and Medina continue as scheduled

openai_nears_up_to_30_billion_funding_ro.headline: OpenAI Targets $1.25 Trillion Valuation in $30 Billion Funding Round
openai_nears_up_to_30_billion_funding_ro.summary: OpenAI is seeking up to $30 billion from UAE investors and Coatue, aiming for a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of a potential 2027 IPO.
highlights: UAE investors lead the round, with Coatue also participating
OpenAI plans to spend roughly $600 billion on compute by 2030
The company filed a confidential prospectus with the SEC but has not set an IPO date

moderna_shares_plunge_after_leak_of_canc.headline: Moderna Shares Plunge 25% After Leak of Cancer Vaccine Data
moderna_shares_plunge_after_leak_of_canc.summary: Moderna’s stock fell 25% after a partial data leak revealed its personalized melanoma vaccine with Merck’s Keytruda cut recurrence risk by 42%, despite overall positive results.
highlights: The vaccine reduced distant metastasis or death by 38% versus Keytruda alone
82% of patients remained disease‑free at two years compared with 70% on Keytruda alone
Manufacturing takes six weeks, but Merck aims to shorten the timeline

comcast_beats_earnings_expectations_as_m.headline: Comcast Beats Earnings Forecast as Media Gains Offset Connectivity Weakness
comcast_beats_earnings_expectations_as_m.summary: Comcast posted $1.07 adjusted EPS, driven by strong Peacock performance and media revenue growth, while its connectivity segment saw declining broadband earnings.
highlights: Peacock earned $261 million EBITDA on $1.8 billion revenue, maintaining 48 million paid subscribers.
Comcast announced a spin‑off of NBCUniversal and Sky, targeting completion by mid‑2027.
Theme‑park revenue fell 4.4% to $2.6 billion, while mobile customers grew by 368,000.

japan_bd_investment.headline: Japan to Mobilize $6.35 Billion Private Investment in Bangladesh
japan_bd_investment.summary: Japan plans to arrange about 1 trillion yen in private-sector funding for Bangladesh over five years, targeting automotive, manufacturing and energy projects.
highlights: Japan aims to channel 1 trillion yen ($6.35 billion) into Bangladesh’s economy over the next five years
Investments will focus on automobile production, other manufacturing sectors and new energy facilities
Japanese firms, including Sumitomo Corporation, may enter Bangladesh’s Special Economic Zone

property_valuation_tax_evasion.headline: Bangladesh to Enforce Market‑Based Property Valuation to Halt Tax Evasion
property_valuation_tax_evasion.summary: The government will require all immovable property registrations to reflect actual market values, with committees assessing prices nationwide and revised taxes effective from July 2027.
highlights: Special committees at divisional, district and upazila levels will determine true market prices within four months.
Revised property registration fees and taxes are slated to commence on 1 July 2027.
CPD estimates the country loses about Tk6,000 crore annually due to undervalued registrations.

bangladeshi_nationals_injured_dammam.headline: Bangladeshi Nationals Injured in Attack on Saudi Dammam Airport, Embassy Visits Hospital
bangladeshi_nationals_injured_dammam.summary: Two Bangladeshis were wounded during the King Fahd International Airport assault in Dammam and are now receiving care at Saudi German Hospital, officials said.
highlights: The Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment confirmed the injuries and hospitalisation of the two nationals.
The victims, from Cumilla and Noakhali, lost consciousness from heat and smoke but sustained no physical injuries.
The attack is part of escalating strikes on Saudi infrastructure amid the Houthi‑Yemeni government conflict.

10yr_yield_drop.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Falls Below 5% Amid AI and Oil Concerns
10yr_yield_drop.summary: Investors rushed to safe‑haven Treasurys as AI‑related bond issuance worries and rising oil prices drove a sharp sell‑off in equities, pushing the 10‑year yield to 4.972%.
highlights: 10‑year yield dropped 17 basis points to 4.972%, its first sub‑5% level since Sept. 23.
2‑year Treasury fell 16 basis points to 4.659%, reflecting short‑term Fed rate expectations.
Oil prices surged, with WTI up 2.39% to $99.47 per barrel, adding geopolitical risk.

sep_core_inflation.headline: Japan Core Inflation Hits 2.1% in September, Prompting Rate Hike Speculation
sep_core_inflation.summary: September core inflation rose to 2.1%, the highest this year, driven by weak yen‑linked import costs and rising durable‑goods prices, fueling BOJ rate‑hike expectations.
highlights: Headline inflation also stood at 2.1% while core‑core inflation reached 2.4%.
Nikkei 225 fell 1.62% as the yen strengthened to 156.15 per dollar.
Rice prices dropped 20.6% year‑on‑year, yet overall goods inflation rose to 2.8%.

chinese_offshore_shift.headline: Wealthy Chinese Shift Offshore Funds to U.S. Banks Amid New Tax Regime
chinese_offshore_shift.summary: As China imposes a 20% tax on overseas trusts, affluent Chinese are rapidly opening U.S. bank accounts to evade CRS reporting and reduce tax exposure.
highlights: U.S. banks are not subject to the OECD Common Reporting Standard, so they do not automatically share client data with Beijing
Chinese offshore trusts face a 20% retroactive tax, prompting transfers from Singapore and Hong Kong to U.S. institutions within
Large private banks attract wealthy clients, while regional banks and online brokers handle smaller accounts

bangladesh_japan_expect_to_sign_over_4_m.headline: Bangladesh and Japan to Sign Over Four MoUs During Prime Minister's Tokyo Visit
bangladesh_japan_expect_to_sign_over_4_m.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will discuss metro rail costs, loan rates and broader cooperation as Bangladesh seeks to deepen its strategic partnership with Japan.
highlights: More than four MoUs covering agriculture, fisheries, skills, aviation and trade are slated for signing.
Infrastructure financing, including Dhaka’s MRT Line‑1 and Line‑5 cost hikes, will be a key discussion topic.

climate_resilient_seeds_help_bangladesh_.headline: Climate‑Resilient Seeds Boost Bangladesh Rice Output Amid Shrinking Farmland
climate_resilient_seeds_help_bangladesh_.summary: Bangladesh increased rice production by 8% despite a 2% drop in cultivated area, thanks to climate‑resilient seed varieties raising yields by 10.3%.
highlights: Yield per acre rose 10.3% between FY21 and FY25.
New BRRI varieties enable rice cultivation in saline coastal Satkhira.

early_winter_vegetables_falling_fish_pri.headline: Early Winter Veggies and Falling Fish Prices Ease Dhaka Shoppers' Burden
early_winter_vegetables_falling_fish_pri.summary: As the Durga Puja holidays reduce demand, early winter vegetables and fish prices drop in Dhaka markets, while chicken, eggs and most groceries stay steady.
highlights: Bean prices fell to Tk140‑150 per kg, eggplant to Tk80 per kg.
Large ruhi fish price slipped to Tk350‑360 per kg amid weaker holiday demand.
Broiler chicken and eggs remained high at Tk180 per kg and Tk150 per dozen.

saab_orders_triple_after_ukraine_gripen_.headline: Saab’s Orders Triple on Gripen Deal with Ukraine, Boosting Earnings
saab_orders_triple_after_ukraine_gripen_.summary: Saab reported third‑quarter earnings beat expectations as new orders surged to 65.8 billion kronor, driven by a 24.6 billion kronor Gripen contract for Ukraine.
highlights: New orders rose to 65.8 billion kronor, more than triple last year.
Saab secured a 24.6 billion kronor contract for 16 Gripen E jets for Ukraine, deliveries 2029‑2030.
Order backlog reached 364.2 billion kronor, a sixth consecutive quarter of growth.

jensen_huang_visits_kazakhstan_for_ai_hu.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Visits Kazakhstan to Boost AI Hub Plans
jensen_huang_visits_kazakhstan_for_ai_hu.summary: Jensen Huang announced Kazakhstan’s $10 billion AI infrastructure drive, aiming to create a low‑cost data‑center hub for Europe using Nvidia GPUs and local talent.
highlights: Kazakhstan plans a 2‑gigawatt AI cluster in Ekibastuz with 300 MW now and up to 1 GW future capacity.
Firebird and Nvidia will co‑invest in building 100,000 advanced GPUs as part of the national AI priority.
German automaker Volkswagen entered Kazakhstan, leveraging its China factories to serve Central Asian markets.

sk_hynix_shares_rebound_after_scrapping_.headline: SK Hynix Shares Rebound After Halting Solidigm IPO Review
sk_hynix_shares_rebound_after_scrapping_.summary: SK Hynix stock rose 4.4% after the company scrapped its review of a U.S. IPO for subsidiary Solidigm, easing investor concerns over governance and funding.
highlights: Shares closed 4.4% higher, reversing earlier 3% losses
SK Hynix will explore alternative financing for Solidigm’s U.S. fab amid AI memory demand
South Korean regulators warned a dual listing could breach rules protecting minority shareholders

investment_scam_tk11cr.headline: Four Arrested in Bangladesh Tk11 Crore Online Investment Scam, Two Are Chinese Nationals
investment_scam_tk11cr.summary: Dhaka magistrate remanded four suspects, including two Chinese nationals, for allegedly embezzling Tk11 crore through promised high‑return online trading and block‑trade share schemes.
highlights: Police seized the suspects in separate raids in Adabor and Bashundhara Residential Area on 22 October.
Investigation revealed Tk8.92 crore transferred through one account and an additional Tk2.07 crore via other accounts.

commercial_terms_delay.headline: Meta pushes back commercial terms rollout amid publisher and advertiser backlash
commercial_terms_delay.summary: Meta Platforms delayed the start of its updated Commercial Terms and Self‑Serve Ad Terms to 20 November, citing the need to address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers.
highlights: Implementation date moved from 30 October to 20 November
Complaints were filed with EU and UK antitrust authorities over AI content usage rights
Meta says extension allows time to explain changes to partners

hotel_fire_seaprincess.headline: Fire Breaks Out at Cox's Bazar's Sea Princess Hotel, Tourists Evacuated
hotel_fire_seaprincess.summary: A generator short‑circuit sparked a blaze at The Sea Princess in Cox's Bazar, prompting about 300 tourists to flee to the beach, with no injuries reported.
highlights: The fire originated in the ground‑floor generator room and was contained before firefighters arrived.
Cox's Bazar Fire Service inspected the hotel afterward and declared it safe.

gtn_berlin_ai_hardware_announcements.headline: Nvidia's GTC Highlights AI Compute Rush Amid Neocloud Stock Selloff
gtn_berlin_ai_hardware_announcements.summary: Jensen Huang unveiled portable AI racks in Berlin while neocloud stocks fell, underscoring capital shortages and soaring demand for AI data centers.
highlights: New Vera Rubin AI rack container can deploy seven racks on a standard truck, speeding data‑center launches.
CoreWeave and Nebius shares dropped 10% and 7% respectively as investors worry about un‑rated neocloud borrowers.
Goldman Sachs projects $7.6 trillion AI‑related capex through 2031, with a 1 GW data center costing about $50 billion.

tik_tok_compute_capacity.headline: TikTok US Seeks Four Gigawatts of Compute Power by 2030
tik_tok_compute_capacity.summary: TikTok US, backed by Oracle, Silver Lake and MGX, aims to secure four gigawatts of cloud capacity to support its new B2B AI product.
highlights: TikTok US plans to obtain four gigawatts of compute by early 2030s
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure remains its primary cloud provider
Investors each hold 15% stakes, with ByteDance retaining 19.9%

family_office_risk_debt_alternatives.headline: Next‑Gen Family Offices to Boost Debt, Alternatives and Philanthropy
family_office_risk_debt_alternatives.summary: As baby boomers hand over $5 trillion in assets, younger family office leaders plan higher debt use, greater alternative investments and a shift toward systemic philanthropy.
highlights: 84% of next‑generation principals intend to use credit for wealth building
79% expect alternatives to grow in portfolio share, with private equity and venture capital each targeted by 41% of millennial

crude_bomb_explosion.headline: Crude Bomb Explodes Near Old Ramna Police Station in Dhaka
crude_bomb_explosion.summary: A crude bomb detonated on Moghbazar Road in front of the old Ramna Police Station on Friday night, with no casualties reported.
highlights: The explosion occurred at approximately 7:45 pm on Moghbazar Road.
Assistant Commissioner Mohammad Mazharul Islam said the perpetrators fled on a motorcycle.
Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the suspects.

verification_dilemma.headline: Bangladesh’s K‑Beauty Boom Faces Verification Challenge Amid Counterfeit Concerns
verification_dilemma.summary: Consumers buying Korean skincare in Bangladesh struggle to verify authenticity as retailers provide limited sourcing details and regulators warn of counterfeit risks.
highlights: Counterfeit Korean cosmetics were seized in South Korea, but verification in Bangladesh remains unclear.
Koba International claims direct imports of Korean brands yet refuses to share supporting documentation.
Bangladesh’s Directorate General of Drug Administration requires registration, but fake stickers still appear on products.

expressway_accident.headline: Fatal Pedestrian Crash on Dhaka’s 300‑Feet Expressway
expressway_accident.summary: A 26‑year‑old man was killed and another injured when a private car struck pedestrians on Dhaka’s 300‑Feet Expressway late evening.
highlights: Accident occurred around 6:30 pm on 23 October on the 300 Feet 36 July Expressway.
Driver fled the scene, leaving victims to be taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
Autopsy was performed at the hospital morgue.

qatar_deal_to_buy_u_s_natural_gas_shows_.headline: Qatar Secures U.S. LNG Deal as Iran War Redraws Energy Map
qatar_deal_to_buy_u_s_natural_gas_shows_.summary: QatarEnergy will buy up to 4 million metric tons of U.S. LNG each year through 2054, a deal that highlights the Iran war’s reshaping of global energy markets.
highlights: The contract is indexed to Henry Hub prices plus a fixed fee, with deliveries slated for the 2030s.
Qatar’s Ras Laffan attack removed about 17% of its LNG capacity, prompting a force majeure and a $3 billion loan from Chinese
Shares of Cheniere and Venture Global have risen 26% and 40% respectively since the war began.

u_s_dropping_some_canada_tariffs_susan_c.headline: Collins Secures Tariff Exemptions for Canadian Imports Amid Maine Senate Race
u_s_dropping_some_canada_tariffs_susan_c.summary: Senator Susan Collins announced U.S. exemptions on nine Canadian product categories, aiming to ease costs for Maine businesses while navigating a tight Senate contest.
highlights: Tariff relief covers items such as corrugated paper, plastic packaging, refrigeration equipment, machinery, and seaweed products.
Collins urged USTR Ambassador Jamieson Greer and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to lower duties on these imports.
The exemptions affect sectors vital to rural and coastal communities in Maine.

investors_are_starting_to_find_opportuni.headline: Investors Eye Treasury Bounce as Bond Market Rout Peaks
investors_are_starting_to_find_opportuni.summary: Investors are shifting into Treasury bonds, betting that soaring yields are topping out after a volatile market driven by inflation fears and AI‑related debt pressures.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield briefly flirted with the 5% psychological level before dropping 19 basis points
Treasury inflows reached $5.4 billion last week, part of $12.1 billion total bond market inflows
iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF attracted $1.14 billion of new cash this month

chickpea_wholesale_price_increase_despit.headline: Bangladesh Chickpea Prices Surge Ahead of Ramadan Despite Record Imports
chickpea_wholesale_price_increase_despit.summary: Wholesale chickpea prices in Chattogram rose Tk17‑21 per kg over two months, even as imports jumped to 17,177 tonnes, sparking fears of artificial shortages.
highlights: Traders cite higher Australian booking rates and lower Aussie production forecasts as price drivers
Ramadan demand can peak at 80,000‑100,000 tonnes monthly, intensifying pressure

china_launches_green_channel_for_banglad.headline: China Opens Green Channel for Bangladeshi Eye Patients at Kunming Hospital
china_launches_green_channel_for_banglad.summary: Bangladeshi patients can now access priority eye care in China through a new green channel offering pre‑travel consultations, interpretation support and post‑treatment follow‑up.
highlights: Kunming Huaxia Eye Hospital will provide priority appointments and a dedicated international service desk for Bangladeshi
Bangladeshi Consul General Shahnaz Ranu inaugurated the green channel and the Huaxia Ophthalmology International Forum 2026 in
The program includes training opportunities for Bangladeshi eye specialists and teleconsultation services to boost domestic

second_ebola_death_reported_in_kenya.headline: Kenya Records Second Ebola Death Amid Growing Regional Outbreak Concerns
second_ebola_death_reported_in_kenya.summary: Kenya confirmed its second Ebola-related fatality as authorities manage quarantine protocols while neighboring countries grapple with the expanding virus spread.
highlights: The 65‑year‑old woman died in Nairobi after ten days of symptoms despite supportive care
Around 135 contacts were traced, with 118 in quarantine and eight testing positive
US travelers from Congo face new screening restrictions for flights to the United States

ai_buildout_turmoil.headline: AI Infrastructure Turmoil Sends Neoclouds Plummeting and Credit Risks Soaring
ai_buildout_turmoil.summary: A wave of stress hits AI build‑out as neocloud stocks tumble, CDS spreads widen, and SK Hynix cancels Solidigm’s IPO amid market volatility.
highlights: Nasdaq fell 0.7% for the week, with Alphabet down 6% ahead of earnings
CoreWeave’s CDS spreads exceeded 11%, and its 2031‑2032 unsecured notes yielded over 15%
Meta reported negative free cash flow of more than $2 billion and raised its full‑year capex target to $135 billion

moody_s_holds_france_rating.headline: Moody's Keeps France Aa3 Rating Amid Unrest and Rising Yields
moody_s_holds_france_rating.summary: Moody's maintained France's Aa3 rating but left a negative outlook as civil unrest and a 10‑year yield above 5% raise fiscal and political risks.
highlights: France's 10‑year bond yield topped 5% for the first time since 2002.
The deficit‑to‑GDP ratio stands at about 5.5%, above the EU's 3% ceiling.
Debt maturing by 2030 exceeds $1 trillion and the debt‑to‑GDP ratio is projected to reach 121.7% in 2027.

black_october_php_flaws.headline: AI‑Driven PHP Flaws Spark Global ‘Black October’ Security Crisis
black_october_php_flaws.summary: Critical PHP vulnerabilities discovered by AI models have forced governments, big tech, and SMEs worldwide to scramble for patches amid an unprecedented cybersecurity emergency.
highlights: Nearly 70% of websites run on PHP, exposing massive attack surface.
Researchers at Google’s Wiz and Calif used OpenAI and Google AI to uncover the flaws.

rooppur_unit_1_power_startup_preparation.institution: Nuclear Power Plant Company Bangladesh Limited (NPCBL)
rooppur_unit_1_power_startup_preparation.headline: Rooppur Unit‑1 Poised for Power Startup Pending BAERA Approval
rooppur_unit_1_power_startup_preparation.summary: Bangladesh’s Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant Unit‑1 is ready to begin power startup on 25 October, awaiting final clearance from BAERA to supply up to 300 MW by year‑end.
highlights: All B‑2 stage tests, including physics tests, have been completed successfully.
The reactor must reach 30‑35% capacity before feeding electricity into the national grid.

tk1_000cr_green_bond_launch.headline: BRAC Bank to Issue Bangladesh’s First Tk1,000 crore Green Bond
tk1_000cr_green_bond_launch.summary: BRAC Bank will launch a Tk1,000 crore, three‑year non‑convertible green bond tomorrow, financing renewable energy, eco‑friendly buildings and industrial energy‑efficiency projects.
highlights: The bond follows Bangladesh Bank’s green bond guidelines and is fully redeemable.
It targets renewable energy, green construction and industrial energy‑efficiency improvements.
BRAC Bank previously issued a Tk1,000 crore social bond in 2025 under Basel III regulations.

plan_to_develop_kuakata_into_world_class.headline: Minister Millat Plans World‑Class Kuakata Beach to Boost Tourism
plan_to_develop_kuakata_into_world_class.summary: Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat announced a coordinated plan to develop Kuakata into an international‑standard beach, creating jobs and revenue.
highlights: Tourist facilities to include modern toilets, safe drinking water, information centres and emergency medical services.
Emphasis on safety measures such as trained lifeguards, rescue operations and waste management.

10y_yield_drop.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Slides Below 5% Amid AI Spending and Oil Price Surge
10y_yield_drop.summary: Investors fled to safety as AI‑related debt concerns and rising crude oil prices pushed the benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield back under 5%, sparking bond market uncertainty.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield settled at 4.999%, just under the 5% threshold.
Crude oil futures closed above $100 per barrel, with WTI at $103.27.
2‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.686%, reflecting Federal Reserve policy expectations.

spacex_tesla_merger.headline: Musk's SpaceX‑Tesla Merger Talk Sparks Market Volatility and Regulatory Scrutiny
spacex_tesla_merger.summary: Elon Musk signaled support for a SpaceX‑Tesla merger, sending both stocks tumbling while investors weigh control motives, antitrust hurdles and cross‑border regulatory challenges.
highlights: Tesla shares fell 3% and are down 17% year‑to‑date
SpaceX stock dropped 9% after earlier gains
Both companies have formed special committees to explore a transaction

tbsnews.net/world/south-asia/delhis-jami.headline: Jamia Millia Islamia Moves Classes Online Amid 13‑Day Hunger Strike
tbsnews.net/world/south-asia/delhis-jami.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia shifted to online teaching as a 13‑day hunger strike over student union elections escalated into clashes with staff.
highlights: The university closed gates and libraries, urging all students to attend classes remotely.
Protesters demand restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students' Union and removal of the chief proctor.

tbsnews.net/world/train-hits-minibus-rus.headline: Train Collides with Minibus in Russia’s Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, Killing Six
tbsnews.net/world/train-hits-minibus-rus.summary: A passenger train struck a minibus attempting to cross at a red signal in Russia’s Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, resulting in six deaths and one injury.
highlights: The minibus ignored a red signal at a level crossing and was hit by a train bound for Blagoveshchensk.
All victims were foreign nationals aboard the minibus; train passengers and crew were unharmed.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/politics/people-a.headline: State Minister Shahe Alam Calls for Sheikh Hasina’s Accountability and Return to Bangladesh
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/politics/people-a.summary: Mir Shahe Alam announced that nationwide demand seeks former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to face justice for alleged misrule, pledging her return and new social cards.
highlights: Shahe Alam said the public wants Sheikh Hasina to face justice for her rule
He promised a "Family Card" for every household and a "Farmer's Card" for each farmer
The gathering was led by BNP leaders in Mokamtala Upazila, Bogura

berkshire_shares_hit_all_time_highs.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Shares Surge to New All‑Time Highs After Buffett Exit
berkshire_shares_hit_all_time_highs.summary: Following Warren Buffett’s 2025 CEO departure, Berkshire’s Class A and B stocks rebounded, achieving record closes amid shifting investor sentiment.
highlights: Class A shares closed at $820,500 and Class B at $546.97, setting fresh record highs.
Berkshire’s B shares rose about 9% in October, outpacing the S&P 500’s 0.4% decline.

nvidia_financing_ai_neoclouds_faces_cred.headline: Nvidia's AI Financing Model Faces First Major Stress Test
nvidia_financing_ai_neoclouds_faces_cred.summary: Nvidia's $36 billion off‑balance‑sheet guarantees for neoclouds are under pressure as credit markets tighten and key partners see shares plunge.
