highlights: CoreWeave CDS spreads exceeded 11%, reflecting heightened default risk.
Nvidia pledged up to $105 billion for OpenAI's proposed 10‑GW Ohio data center.

trump_executive_order_to_cut_mortgage_in.headline: Trump Order Cuts Mortgage Insurance and Refinance Costs for Borrowers
trump_executive_order_to_cut_mortgage_in.summary: The new executive order mandates the FHFA to cancel mortgage insurance for eligible loans and make refinancing cheaper, aiming to lower homeowner expenses amid rising rates.
highlights: Mortgage insurance could be eliminated once borrowers reach 20% equity under the pilot program
The refinancing pilot waives lender title insurance for loans with LTV below 80%, potentially saving $500‑$1,500 in closing costs
Current 30‑year fixed rates sit at 7.32%, and refinance demand fell 59% year‑over‑year

website_offline_security_vulnerability.headline: Bangladesh Bank Website Remains Offline Amid Global PHP Vulnerability
website_offline_security_vulnerability.summary: Bangladesh Bank has kept its website offline since October 22 while technical teams assess critical PHP flaws that could enable remote cyber attacks on servers.
highlights: The shutdown affects not only Bangladesh Bank but also several commercial banks using PHP‑based sites.
Global institutions in France, the Netherlands and Belgium have taken similar precautionary actions.
BGD e‑GOV CIRT issued an alert urging organizations to audit PHP versions and apply security patches immediately.

germany_development_cooperation_visit.headline: Germany Strengthens Development Cooperation Ahead of Bangladesh’s LDC Graduation
germany_development_cooperation_visit.summary: German BMZ Vice Minister Dr. Bärbel Kofler will lead talks in Dhaka to reshape aid into long‑term resilience and sustainable growth as Bangladesh prepares to exit LDC status.
highlights: Dr. Bärbel Kofler leads a three‑day German delegation visit to Dhaka.
Discussions will shift focus from traditional aid to long‑term resilience and economic adaptability.
The visit coincides with Bangladesh’s upcoming graduation from Least Developed Country status.

crude_price_six_month_high.headline: Global Oil Prices Surge to Six-Month High Amid Middle East Tensions
crude_price_six_month_high.summary: Brent crude closed at $116.72 per barrel, its highest since April, as fears of US strikes on Iran and Saudi drone attacks drive supply concerns.
highlights: Brent rose 3.1% to $116.72 while WTI jumped 3.8% to $103.27 per barrel
Saudi Aramco ordered staff to work remotely after drone strikes on the Shaybah field and Dammam airport
The US Department of State evacuated non‑essential personnel from Saudi Arabia

france_riots_market_risk.headline: France Unrest Pushes Bond Yields to 2002 High, Investors Wary
france_riots_market_risk.summary: Rising protests in France have driven 10‑year OAT yields to their highest since 2002, sparking investor concerns over fiscal targets and growth prospects.
highlights: Moody's kept France's Aa3 rating but maintained a negative outlook due to political fragmentation
The spread between French OATs and German Bunds widened to its widest since November 2011
Carrefour shares fell over 14% after cutting profit outlook citing unrest and rising energy costs

ai_funding_fears_impact_markets.headline: AI Funding Fears Shake Wall Street as Meta Reports Cash Flow Loss
ai_funding_fears_impact_markets.summary: Investors worried that massive AI infrastructure spending may outpace available capital, prompting a sell‑off that dragged the Dow below 1% and lifted defensive stocks.
highlights: Meta warned its long‑term AI plans could need hundreds of billions in financing, sending its shares down 9% for the week.
Nvidia slipped about 1.5% while CoreWeave fell 10% amid concerns over debt‑fuelled AI spending.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.4% weekly despite overall market volatility.

govt_defers_proposal_to_buy_lng_from_jer.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Defers JERA LNG Purchase Pending Legal Review
govt_defers_proposal_to_buy_lng_from_jer.summary: The government postponed approval to buy LNG from Japan's JERA Global Markets until the Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division completes a legal vetting of the contract.
highlights: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs delayed the LNG deal pending legal review.
Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury chaired the meeting where the proposal was discussed.

pm_to_leave_for_japan_tonight_on_four_da.headline: Bangladesh Prime Minister Begins Four-Day Japan Visit to Boost Economic Ties
pm_to_leave_for_japan_tonight_on_four_da.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman departs Dhaka for a four‑day visit to Japan, meeting Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Japanese business leaders to strengthen trade and investment ties.
highlights: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will attend the Bangladesh‑Japan Economic Forum and meet top Japanese officials
The itinerary includes meetings with JICA, the Nippon Foundation and the Japan‑Bangladesh Parliamentary Friendship League

german_vice_minister_to_arrive_in_dhaka_.institution: German Embassy / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
german_vice_minister_to_arrive_in_dhaka_.headline: German Vice Minister Kofler Arrives in Dhaka for Development Cooperation Talks
german_vice_minister_to_arrive_in_dhaka_.summary: German Vice Minister Bärbel Kofler begins a three‑day visit to discuss long‑term resilience, economic adaptability and sustainable growth with Bangladeshi officials.
highlights: Kofler will hold G2G negotiations on development cooperation
The visit coincides with Bangladesh’s preparation to graduate from LDC status

why_popular_airplanes_are_getting_scrapp.headline: Young Aircraft Retirements Surge as Engine Shortages Drive Early Scrappage
why_popular_airplanes_are_getting_scrapp.summary: A shortage of jet engines and rising part costs are forcing airlines to retire narrow‑body planes like the Airbus A320neo after just a few years of service.
highlights: Average retirement age fell to 6.4 years, far below the typical 21.7 years for narrow‑body jets
Engine fan blades now fetch $50,000‑$100,000, while whole engines can exceed $17 million
Renting a replacement engine costs up to $180,000 per month, straining airline budgets

rampal_442mw_solar_tender.headline: Bangladesh to Tender 442MW Rampal Solar Plant with 2% PSDF Financing
rampal_442mw_solar_tender.summary: The Bangladesh Power Development Board will issue tenders for a 442 MW solar project in Rampal, financed at 2% by the Power Sector Development Fund.
highlights: Construction will begin next year with operation targeted for June 2029, adding 442 MW of green electricity to the Khulna
The project costs Tk2,498.08 crore, funded by Tk374.71 crore from BPDB and a Tk2,123.37 crore PSDF loan at 2% interest, with a
A tariff of Tk6.18 per unit is set, roughly 30% lower than the projected Tk8.87 per unit for a 220 MW solar plant in Sonagazi.

lng_cargo_purchase_bp_singapore_qatar.headline: Bangladesh Govt Approves Six LNG Cargo Purchases Below JKM Benchmark
lng_cargo_purchase_bp_singapore_qatar.summary: Bangladesh's Cabinet Committee on Government Purchase approved six LNG cargoes—five from BP Singapore and one from Qatar Energy Trading—at $0.17 and $0.10 per MMBtu below the JKM benchmark.
highlights: Five cargoes bought from BP Singapore at $0.17 per MMBtu below JKM
One cargo from Qatar Energy Trading at $0.10 per MMBtu below JKM

us_technical_support_food_safety_grain_s.headline: Bangladesh Food Minister Seeks US Technical Aid for Grain Safety and Storage
us_technical_support_food_safety_grain_s.summary: Food Minister Afroza Khanam requested US expertise to test imported rice and wheat quality and to develop climate‑resilient long‑term storage solutions for Bangladesh’s grain supply.
highlights: US Ambassador Brent T. Christensen met Khanam to discuss cooperation on food security
The request targets quality testing at Chattogram and Mongla ports and storage upgrades amid Bangladesh’s climatic challenges
Recent US wheat shipments have arrived on schedule without reported issues

democrats_voting_rights_groups_challenge.headline: Democrats and Voting‑Rights Groups Challenge DOJ Attempt to Block Alaska Senate Certification
democrats_voting_rights_groups_challenge.summary: Democratic allies argue the Justice Department lacks authority to intervene in Alaska’s Senate race, seeking to stop a lawsuit that could prevent certification of the results.
highlights: The DOJ filed the suit on Oct. 22 to block certification if incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan loses.
Groups including Alaskans for Mary and the League of Women Voters seek defendant‑intervenor status to dismiss the case.

australian_firms_explore_bangladesh_inve.headline: Australian Renewable Energy Firms Seek Investment Opportunities in Bangladesh
australian_firms_explore_bangladesh_inve.summary: Australian renewable energy companies are exploring Bangladesh’s clean‑energy market, aiming to partner with local firms and attract investment for decarbonisation projects.
highlights: Seminar organized by ABCCI and Austrade gathered 150 stakeholders to discuss renewable projects
IFC highlighted Bangladesh’s renewable energy targets and investment potential
B2B matchmaking enabled Australian SMEs to meet Bangladeshi partners

15_utility_scale_solar_ppp_projects_line.headline: Invest Bangladesh Unveils 15 Solar PPP Projects to Attract Global Investors
15_utility_scale_solar_ppp_projects_line.summary: Invest Bangladesh presented a portfolio of 15 utility‑scale solar projects and infrastructure opportunities at the World Investment Forum, aiming to draw capital into the country's renewable energy sector.
highlights: The portfolio includes solar projects on government land alongside LNG infrastructure and the proposed Chattogram Free Trade Zone.
Invest Bangladesh showcased the projects to around 100 institutional investors and financiers at the UNCTAD‑organized forum in

pm_seeks_japanese_backing_for_energy_sec.headline: Bangladesh Prime Minister Seeks Japanese Backing for Energy Security and Investment
pm_seeks_japanese_backing_for_energy_sec.summary: During a Tokyo summit, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman requested concessional loans, budget aid and expanded Japanese investment to secure Bangladesh’s energy future and modernise key industries.
highlights: Bangladesh asks for budget support and concessional loans from Japan
Prime Minister urges increased Japanese investment in renewable energy, ICT and advanced manufacturing
JICA President reaffirmed commitment to Bangladesh’s development projects

china_industrial_profits_sept.headline: China’s Industrial Profits Surge on AI Boom Amid Domestic Demand Weakness
china_industrial_profits_sept.summary: Industrial profits rose 14.4% YoY in September, driven by AI‑related manufacturing gains, while weak consumer demand and property woes keep overall growth uneven.
highlights: Large firms posted a 14.4% profit increase in September year‑on‑year.
Electronics special‑materials makers saw profits more than triple and semiconductor equipment profits rose 51.7%.

oil_fall_diplomacy.headline: Oil Prices Slip as Diplomatic Push Eases Middle East Supply Fears
oil_fall_diplomacy.summary: Brent fell to $114.80 and WTI to $100.88 as talks among Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan and Iran eased worries about supply disruptions.
highlights: Brent crude slipped 0.87% to $114.80 per barrel
WTI fell 0.86% to $100.88 per barrel
Talks involving Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan and Iran aimed to defuse regional tensions

arctic_trade_redraw.headline: China, Russia Expand Arctic Shipping as Europe Scrambles to Respond
arctic_trade_redraw.summary: China and Russia are tightening control over Arctic routes, while the EU launches a strategy to boost icebreakers and infrastructure, but Europe’s leverage remains limited.
highlights: Moscow controls the Northern Sea Route, issuing permits, fees and operating a fleet of nuclear icebreakers.
The Northern Sea Route can cut Asia‑Europe voyages to 18‑22 days, about 35% faster than the Suez corridor.
Arctic trade currently represents only about 0.3% of global shipping, projected to reach roughly 1% by 2030.

dhaka_tokyo_to_upgrade_big_b_into_shared.headline: Bangladesh and Japan Upgrade BIG‑B to Shared Prosperity Initiative
dhaka_tokyo_to_upgrade_big_b_into_shared.summary: Bangladesh and Japan pledged $6.34 billion in private investment and 200,000 jobs while expanding the BIG‑B corridor into a logistics, energy and industrial hub.
highlights: Japan aims to invest up to 1 trillion yen in Bangladesh over five years.
The Matarbari Deep‑Sea Port will become the centerpiece of the upgraded BIG‑B framework.
Five cooperation memoranda were signed covering trade, agriculture, fisheries, livestock and environmental protection.

food_minister_proposes_russian_financed_.headline: Bangladesh Plans Russian‑Financed Wheat Silo at Payra Port to Boost Supply
food_minister_proposes_russian_financed_.summary: Food Minister Afroza Khanam announced a Russian‑financed wheat silo at Payra Sea Port, initially storing 2‑5 lakh tonnes to improve national supply management.
highlights: Initial capacity set at 2 lakh metric tonnes, expandable to 5 lakh tonnes
Port infrastructure at Payra enables efficient transport to Narayanganj and Sirajganj
Russia proposes G2G wheat exports alongside silo financing

railway_adds_third_pair_of_trains_on_dha.headline: Bangladesh Railway Launches Third Train Pair on Dhaka‑Cox’s Bazar Route
railway_adds_third_pair_of_trains_on_dha.summary: The Mohanagar Express extension adds capacity for about 1,500 passengers daily, creating a third pair of trains on the Dhaka‑Cox’s Bazar intercity line.
highlights: Mohanagar Express will carry up to 1,500 additional passengers each day.
Three pairs of trains now operate, with the new service departing Dhaka at 8:30 pm.
The 467.83 km route includes 12 intermediate stations and takes nine hours 30 minutes.

fed_rate_hikes_not_this_week.headline: Fed Likely to Pause This Week, Eyes December Rate Hikes
fed_rate_hikes_not_this_week.summary: A CNBC survey of 30 experts shows 93% expect a pause at this week’s Fed meeting, while 76% anticipate a rate hike in December.
highlights: 70% of respondents view inflation as broader than energy price spikes
Average 10-year Treasury yield expected to stay above 5% this year

fed_hold_rates_expectations.headline: Fed Likely Holds Rates as Warsh Signals Future Hikes Amid Stubborn Inflation
fed_hold_rates_expectations.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to keep benchmark rates unchanged this week, while Chairman Kevin Warsh hints that further tightening may be needed as CPI stays above target.
highlights: Core CPI remains at 2.6% annual rate, well above the Fed’s 2% goal.
FedWatch tool shows over 80% probability of a rate hike in December.

lula_wins_brazil_runoff.headline: Lula Defeats Bolsonaro in Brazil Runoff Defying Prediction Market Odds
lula_wins_brazil_runoff.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won Brazil’s presidential runoff with 51.8% against Flávio Bolsonaro’s 48.2%, surprising markets that had given Lula only a 21% chance.
highlights: Lula secured 51.8% of the vote versus Bolsonaro’s 48.2%.
Prediction markets gave Lula only a 21% chance shortly before the result.
Brazil‑linked stocks and ETFs fell sharply, with EWZ down 22% and major banks losing up to 30%.

japan_investment_6_34bn_bangladesh.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Japanese Investment to Boost Jobs and LDC Graduation
japan_investment_6_34bn_bangladesh.summary: Bangladesh's prime minister urged Japan to invest $6.34 billion in job‑creating sectors and support a smooth transition out of the LDC category.
highlights: Japan's private sector aims to create about 200,000 jobs in Bangladesh over five years.
The two governments plan to fast‑track the Bangladesh‑Japan Economic Partnership Agreement and set up a joint ministerial
Japan pledged development assistance of 5 billion yen (≈$34 million) for infrastructure and technology projects.

germany_bangladesh_partnership.institution: German Vice Minister for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)
germany_bangladesh_partnership.headline: Germany Reaffirms Long‑Term Partnership with Bangladesh Amid LDC Graduation
germany_bangladesh_partnership.summary: German Vice Minister Dr Bärbel Kofler pledged continued development cooperation and discussed future free‑trade talks as Bangladesh prepares to graduate from LDC status.
highlights: Germany highlighted 55‑year bilateral ties and its role in climate adaptation, energy security and economic reforms.
Discussions on a potential EU‑Bangladesh free trade agreement will hinge on sustained reforms as Bangladesh nears LDC graduation.
The visit included meetings with government, business leaders and civil society to assess challenges like rising prices and

telco_spectrum_price_cuts.headline: Bangladesh Telcos Push for Deeper Cuts in Spectrum Renewal Prices
telco_spectrum_price_cuts.summary: Mobile operators argue that current spectrum renewal costs, double the global average, hinder network expansion and service quality, urging BTRC to lower fees.
highlights: Operators plan to renew 79.2 MHz of spectrum on 10 November, costing about Tk13,100.50 crore if cuts approved.
Spectrum charges represent 15.7% of operator revenue, versus a 7.7% global average.
Proposed 20‑year renewal term with equal annual instalments and no price revision.

lulafiscaltightrope.headline: Lula’s Re‑Election Sends Brazil Stock Index Plummeting Amid Fiscal Tightrope
lulafiscaltightrope.summary: Lula’s surprise win triggered a 13.9% Ibovespa drop, a near‑8% real slump and soaring bond yields as investors fear unsustainable fiscal expansion.
highlights: Brazil’s 10‑year bond yield rose 2.46 percentage points to its highest level in over a decade.
The Treasury cancelled two planned bond auctions amid demand concerns.

hondacanadatariffthreat.headline: Honda warns 50% Canada auto tariffs would cripple industry
hondacanadatariffthreat.summary: Honda senior VP Jennifer Thomas warned that a proposed rise to 50% tariffs on Canadian vehicles and parts could devastate the North American auto sector.
highlights: Trump has threatened to double tariffs from 25% to 50% starting Jan. 1 if no new trade deal is reached
Honda and other manufacturers are urging a trilateral USMCA‑style agreement that includes Mexico to maintain competitiveness
U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer moved the USMCA into an annual review, ending its automatic 16‑year extension

bangaaicapital.headline: World Bank President Banga Says AI‑Driven Capital Demand Won’t Tighten Funding
bangaaicapital.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga affirmed that despite AI‑driven borrowing costs rising, $112 billion in capital remains accessible, especially for emerging‑market infrastructure projects.
highlights: The World Bank mobilized $112 billion last year, three times its level three years earlier.
Emerging markets focus AI investments on infrastructure such as bridges and roads, unlike developed economies targeting

janata_bank_uae_branch_closure.headline: Janata Bank Appeals for Govt Help as UAE Regulator Orders Branch Closures
janata_bank_uae_branch_closure.summary: Janata Bank’s board has urged Bangladesh’s government to intervene after the UAE central bank mandated winding down its four branches due to capital shortfall.
highlights: The CBUAE raised the minimum paid‑up capital for foreign banks to 400 million dirhams, far above Janata Bank’s 100 million
Janata Bank transferred 300 million dirhams to its New York nostro account, but the regulator did not recognise it as capital.

cable_market_shrinkage.headline: Bangladesh Cable Market Shrinks 25% Amid Demand Slump
cable_market_shrinkage.summary: Falling public infrastructure spending, a housing slowdown and high borrowing costs have cut Bangladesh’s cable industry revenue by about 25% in two years.
highlights: Market value fell from Tk12,000 crore in 2022 to roughly Tk8,000‑9,000 crore.
Over 100 manufacturers now compete for fewer orders, with many factories shutting and workers owed up to 30 months wages.

uniqlo_rmg_investment_urged.headline: PM Tarique Urges Uniqlo to Boost Investment in Bangladesh RMG
uniqlo_rmg_investment_urged.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman called on Uniqlo’s parent Fast Retailing to increase capital in Bangladesh’s garment sector, focusing on man‑made fibres, technical textiles and sustainable apparel.
highlights: Government will facilitate land allocation, investment approvals and administrative clearances for Uniqlo’s expansion
Both parties emphasized implementing the Bangladesh‑Japan Economic Partnership Agreement to deepen trade ties

houthi_missile_attack_on_ras_tanura_refi.headline: Oil Prices Rise After Houthi Missile Attack on Saudi Refinery
houthi_missile_attack_on_ras_tanura_refi.summary: Brent crude jumped to $115.59 and WTI to $101.37 as Houthi missile strikes on Ras Tanura sparked fears of prolonged Middle‑East supply disruptions.
highlights: Brent futures rose $1.50, up 1.32%, to $115.59 per barrel
WTI futures gained $1.47, up 1.47%, to $101.37 per barrel
Israel’s election stalemate adds to regional risk premium

boeing_shares_slide_after_disappointing_.headline: Boeing Shares Drop 10% After Disappointing Long‑Term Cash‑Flow Guidance
boeing_shares_slide_after_disappointing_.summary: Boeing reported a 4% revenue rise but warned that free cash flow will lag expectations through 2029, sending the stock down 10%.
highlights: Free cash flow forecast $3 billion for 2027 versus $5.7 billion consensus
Record $745 billion order backlog but production ramp to 52 jets per month delayed to late 2027
CEO Kelly Ortberg emphasized fuel‑efficient 737 Max appeal amid high jet‑fuel prices

robinhood_shares_fall_4_as_crypto_slump_.headline: Robinhood Shares Slip 4% Amid Crypto Revenue Decline
robinhood_shares_fall_4_as_crypto_slump_.summary: Robinhood reported a 4% after‑hours share drop as Q3 earnings missed forecasts, with crypto revenue plunging 55% despite growth in options and event contracts.
highlights: Earnings per share were 51 cents, below the 56‑cent consensus.
Transaction‑based revenue rose 19% to $867 million, driven by a 500% surge in event‑contract revenue.
Net deposits reached $15.7 billion, marking a 17% annualized increase.

power_grid_forms_5_member_probe_committe.headline: Power Grid Bangladesh Forms Probe Committee After 5,370MW Failure
power_grid_forms_5_member_probe_committe.summary: A five‑member probe committee was created to investigate the 5,370 MW grid collapse that cut gas and coal generation by up to 60 % across Dhaka and Chattogram.
highlights: Generation fell from 14,719 MW to 9,349 MW within one hour
Gas‑fired output dropped 60%, coal‑fired output dropped 39%
The probe committee, led by Syed Ebadullah Haider Ali, must report within five working days

pm_urges_japan_bank_for_international_co.headline: Bangladesh PM Urges JBIC to Open Dhaka Office for Investment Boost
pm_urges_japan_bank_for_international_co.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman asked Japan Bank for International Cooperation to establish a Dhaka office, aiming to deepen investment in Bangladesh's energy, ICT and infrastructure sectors.
highlights: JBIC Governor Kazuhiko Amakawa met the PM in Tokyo and said he will consider the office proposal
Bangladesh is reforming regulations to create a business‑friendly environment for foreign investors

indian_firm_l_t_wins_up_to_1b_dhaka_metr.headline: L&T Secures Up to $1 Billion for Dhaka Metro Rail Line 1
indian_firm_l_t_wins_up_to_1b_dhaka_metr.summary: Indian conglomerate Larsen & Toubro won contracts worth up to $1 billion to design and build key track, electrical and signalling packages for Bangladesh’s first underground metro line.
highlights: L&T will handle track works, electrical systems, signalling, telecommunications and platform screen doors for Line 1.
The contracts total about Tk 58,500 crore (~$1 billion) and are classified as a “major” order.
Funding for the metro projects comes from Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).

ai_integration.headline: Oracle Teams Up with OpenAI, Adds Google and OpenAI AI Chips
ai_integration.summary: Oracle announced expanded OpenAI collaboration, embedding ChatGPT and Codex in its apps while unveiling support for Google TPU and OpenAI’s Jalapeño AI chips on OCI.
highlights: Oracle observed GPT-6 Astra training at its Stargate data center in Texas
Cerebras chip deal boosts Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with Cerebras stock up 8%

ai_policy_memo.headline: Amazon Warns Engineers Against Tokenmaxxing in New AI Guidelines
ai_policy_memo.summary: Amazon's internal memo urges engineers to use AI judiciously, discouraging tokenmaxxing and emphasizing long‑term outcomes over raw token counts.
highlights: Amazon shut down an internal leaderboard after detecting tokenmaxxing abuse
AI impact will be measured by feature velocity and long‑term outcomes rather than raw token usage
Engineers are encouraged to explain when AI tools do not add value to their tasks

brac_bank_profit_q3_2026.headline: BRAC Bank Net Profit Surges to Tk2,120.95 crore in Nine Months
brac_bank_profit_q3_2026.summary: BRAC Bank's consolidated net profit jumped 38% year‑on‑year to Tk2,120.95 crore in Jan‑Sept 2026, driven by higher operating income and strong revenue growth.
highlights: Consolidated operating income rose to Tk7,726 crore, up from Tk6,135 crore a year earlier.
Net interest income increased to Tk1,655 crore, while investment income grew to Tk4,143.64 crore.
Classified loan ratio remained low at 2.45%, indicating disciplined credit risk management.

banking_sector_recovery_2027.headline: Bangladesh Bank Targets Banking Sector Recovery by Early 2027
banking_sector_recovery_2027.summary: Bangladesh Bank aims for visible improvements in banks' financial health by March‑April 2027 through asset reviews, NPL reduction and governance reforms.
highlights: Non‑performing loan ratio fell from 36% to 31% since December 2025.
Asset quality reviews completed for 15 banks, with World Bank support for the rest.
A Bank Restructuring and Resolution Fund is being set up to handle distressed institutions.

us_ambassador_fdi_appeal.institution: US Embassy / Chittagong Chamber of Commerce
us_ambassador_fdi_appeal.headline: US Envoy Calls for Cutting Red Tape to Boost Bangladesh FDI
highlights: Chattogram Port delays and non‑tariff barriers hinder trade
Bangladesh aims to cut logistics costs from 40% to under 7% to spur growth
Bangladesh signed the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade, the first in the region with the United States

the_uk_cuts_energy_bills_taxes_banks_and.headline: UK Budget Cuts Energy Bills, Taxes Banks, Boosts Defense Spending
the_uk_cuts_energy_bills_taxes_banks_and.summary: Finance Minister John Healey's autumn budget offers household energy relief, raises bank taxes, and pledges £10 billion for Ukraine while targeting a 3.5% defence spend by 2035.
highlights: Standing charges on gas heating removed and electricity tax break extended to July 2027
Bank surcharge increased by 3% to a 6% levy
Minimum wage rises 3.9% and £100 checks for lowest housing tax bands funded

fedex_beats_expectations_raises_outlook_.headline: FedEx Beats Forecast, Raises Full-Year Outlook After Fiscal Realignment
fedex_beats_expectations_raises_outlook_.summary: FedEx reported adjusted earnings of $3.74 per share, topping estimates, and lifted its 2026 earnings outlook to $18‑$18.60 per share on a 12% revenue growth forecast.
highlights: Revenue reached $22.86 billion, exceeding the $22.42 billion consensus
Express U.S. segment operating income rose thanks to higher package yields and volume
Jamere Jackson, former AutoZone executive, will become CFO on Nov. 30

china_s_tech_darlings_are_losing_their_s.headline: Chinese Tech Stocks Slide as AI Profitability Doubts Grow
china_s_tech_darlings_are_losing_their_s.summary: China's STAR 50 Index fell over 40% as investors question whether AI spending can translate into earnings and sustain high valuations.
highlights: STAR 50 Index dropped more than 40% from its July peak
Battery maker CATL slid 37% YTD despite 59% revenue growth but only 15% profit increase
Weak domestic consumption and property downturn pressure Chinese internet and advertising revenues

bangladesh_malaysia_conclude_first_fta_t.headline: Bangladesh and Malaysia Conclude First FTA Negotiation Round
bangladesh_malaysia_conclude_first_fta_t.summary: Bangladesh and Malaysia finished their initial free trade talks, reviewing draft chapters on goods, services and digital trade, with a follow‑up session slated for January 2027.
highlights: Thirteen working groups examined draft chapters covering goods, services, rules of origin and digital trade
Both countries aim to boost investment and technology cooperation ahead of Bangladesh’s LDC graduation
The next negotiation round is scheduled for January 2027 to resolve remaining chapter differences

power_start_up_process_at_rooppur_unit_1.headline: Bangladesh Approves Power Start‑Up for Rooppur Unit 1 Nuclear Plant
power_start_up_process_at_rooppur_unit_1.summary: BAERA’s green light lets Rooppur Unit 1 enter Stage C, where reactor power will be raised gradually and tested before synchronising with the national grid.
highlights: Unit 1 has completed B‑2 phase physical tests and moved to Stage C.
Commissioning will assess reactor, turbine‑generator, electrical, and safety systems under increasing power.
Final grid synchronisation and commercial operation require additional regulator approvals.

150_tonnes_of_pakistani_tobacco_in_10_co.headline: Bangladesh Seizes 150 Tonnes Pakistani Tobacco Over Tax Evasion
150_tonnes_of_pakistani_tobacco_in_10_co.summary: Customs intelligence seized 150 tonnes of raw tobacco from Pakistan, alleging misdeclaration that could evade up to Tk21.12 crore in revenue.
highlights: The shipment, valued at $1.45 per kg, was imported by Global Leaf Tobacco Company Ltd under bonded warehouse facilities.
Inspection of the company's Kushtia warehouse revealed a shortfall of 257,369 kg raw tobacco and unpaid VAT of Tk3.29 crore.
The cargo was exported by Alif Traders Ltd for Dubai-based Tetrad FZCO and arrived on a vessel operated by Team Bangladesh Ltd.

lagarde_steps_down.headline: ECB President Lagarde to Step Down, Succession Race Heats Up
lagarde_steps_down.summary: Christine Lagarde will leave the ECB on Feb.
highlights: Lagarde departs nine months before her term ends, ending a tenure that saw inflation peak above 11% in 2022.
Potential successors include Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos and Netherlands’ Klaas Knot, each bringing different policy leanings.

key_rate_held_at_2_5.headline: ECB Holds Deposit Rate at 2.5% Amid Rising Energy Inflation
key_rate_held_at_2_5.summary: The ECB kept its key deposit rate at 2.5% as euro‑zone inflation rose to 3.8%, citing energy price risks and stable underlying inflation.
highlights: Energy price inflation hit 18.8% driven by Middle East tensions
Average 10‑year sovereign yields rose about 35 basis points

q3_u_s_gdp_3_4.headline: U.S. Q3 GDP Grows 3.4% Amid Rising September Inflation
q3_u_s_gdp_3_4.summary: The Commerce Department reported a 3.4% annualized Q3 GDP rise, outpacing forecasts, while September's PCE inflation hit 3.6% annually, above the Fed’s 2% target.
highlights: Core PCE inflation eased to 3.1% year‑over‑year
Consumer spending grew 0.5% in September, slightly below forecasts
Gross private domestic investment surged 19.4% driven by equipment spending

ldc_graduation_extension.headline: Bangladesh Granted Three‑Year Extension Before LDC Graduation
ldc_graduation_extension.summary: The UN General Assembly approved a three‑year extension to 2029, giving Bangladesh extra time to boost export competitiveness and implement key economic reforms.
highlights: Extension moves the graduation deadline from 2026 to 24 November 2029.
Garment sector expects relief as preferential market access may be lost after graduation.

green_financing_gap_4_8bn.headline: Bangladesh RMG Sector Faces $4.8 Billion Green Finance Gap
green_financing_gap_4_8bn.summary: The ready‑made garment industry needs $6.6 billion in green investment by 2029 but lacks $4.8 billion in accessible financing, experts warn.
highlights: Panelists urged simplifying loan procedures and adding government‑backed credit guarantees
They emphasized inclusive transition to ensure small factories and women workers benefit

tile_price_hike.institution: Bangladesh Ceramic Manufacturers and Exporters Association
tile_price_hike.headline: Bangladesh Tile Makers Raise Prices by Tk1‑2 per Sq‑Ft
tile_price_hike.summary: Bangladesh ceramic manufacturers announced a symbolic Tk1‑2 per square foot price hike, still far below soaring gas and raw‑material costs, adding modest expense for buyers.
highlights: Wall tiles rise by Tk1 per sq‑ft and floor tiles by Tk2, raising prices up to 3‑4% for low‑priced products.
Industrial gas prices have surged by about 300% over six years, driving higher production costs.
Manufacturers estimate the hike adds only Tk1,000‑2,000 revenue per 1,000 sq‑ft sold, still leaving them operating at a loss.

downgrade_z_category.headline: ICB Shares Downgraded to Z Category After Two Years Without Dividends
downgrade_z_category.summary: State‑owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh cut its FY2025‑26 loss by half but failed to declare dividends for a second straight year, triggering a Z‑category downgrade.
highlights: Consolidated net loss fell to Tk652.55 crore, down from Tk1,213 crore in FY25.
Share price dropped 4.07% to Tk33 after the Z‑category downgrade.
Net asset value per share fell to Tk30.26 from Tk37.45 a year earlier.

quarterly_profit_nearly_double.headline: Shell Doubles Quarterly Profit as Record Refining Margins Hit $42 per Barrel
quarterly_profit_nearly_double.summary: Shell reported a $10.81 billion profit, driven by $42‑per‑barrel refining margins and higher crude prices amid geopolitical global turmoil.
highlights: Free cash flow rose to $16.3 billion, up from $10 billion year‑on‑year.
Shell announced a $5 billion share buyback program, increasing the prior quarter’s $3 billion plan.

fuel_cost_strategies_amid_high_oil_price.headline: Cruise Giants Diverge on Fuel Cost Strategies Amid Oil Surge
fuel_cost_strategies_amid_high_oil_price.summary: Rising Brent crude to $116.72 per barrel forces Carnival, Royal Caribbean and Norwegian Cruise Line to adopt contrasting approaches—fuel‑efficiency cuts versus hedging—to protect earnings.
highlights: Carnival cut unit fuel consumption by 26% since 2019, saving about $700 million in 2026
Royal Caribbean is over 60% hedged for 2026, insulating it from rising fuel costs
Norwegian Cruise Line hedged roughly 48% of its fuel use in 2026, spending $196 million in Q3

china_payments_partnership_expansion.headline: Tencent and Visa Expand Cross‑Border Payments in China After Regulatory Approval
china_payments_partnership_expansion.summary: Following new green lights for U.S. firms, Tencent and Visa will broaden Weixin Pay integration and Visa Direct services, aiming to simplify travel payments and AI‑driven commerce in China.
highlights: Visa received People’s Bank of China approval to prepare a domestic card‑clearing business
The memorandum will enable travelers to pay merchants via Weixin Pay and Visa networks

plastic_recycling_needs_more_investment_.institution: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
plastic_recycling_needs_more_investment_.headline: Bangladesh Needs More Investment and Stronger Policies for Plastic Recycling
plastic_recycling_needs_more_investment_.summary: Experts say waste collection alone won’t curb plastic pollution and call for increased investment, robust EPR enforcement, and better waste‑segregation capacity across Bangladesh.
highlights: Plastic industry contributes about 1% of Bangladesh’s GDP, while the waste sector accounts for 7‑8%.
Plastic recycling currently adds less than 0.25% to GDP, indicating large growth potential.
UNIDO‑backed project developed the PlasticPath digital platform and EPR guidelines.

india_leads_globally_in_green_hydrogen_o.headline: India Leads Global Green Hydrogen Offtake Market with Record Contracts
india_leads_globally_in_green_hydrogen_o.summary: India's green hydrogen offtake commitments now exceed 5.5 lakh tonnes per annum, driven by export deals with Japan, Germany, South Korea and Sri Lanka.
highlights: Investments in green hydrogen projects total around Rs90,000 crore ($9.5 billion).
The National Green Hydrogen Mission targets at least 5 million tonnes per annum by 2030.
Indian firms secured multi‑billion‑dollar offtake agreements for green ammonia and methanol.

2_chinese_nationals_placed_on_7_day_rema.headline: Two Chinese Nationals Charged with Smuggling 12kg Gold Paste in Dhaka Airport
2_chinese_nationals_placed_on_7_day_rema.summary: Two Chinese travelers were remanded for allegedly concealing approximately 12kg of 24‑carat gold paste in their clothing, prompting a Tk24 crore customs seizure at Hazrat Shahjalal Airport.
highlights: The suspects arrived on Emirates flight EK586 from Dubai on 28 October.
Customs officials intercepted them at the green channel and recovered about 6 kg of gold paste from each passenger.
Dhaka Customs House valued the seized gold paste at roughly Tk24 crore.

boj_rate_hold_2026_10_30.headline: BOJ Holds Rates as Underlying Inflation Meets 2% Target for First Time Since 2013
boj_rate_hold_2026_10_30.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate at 1.25% after confirming underlying inflation aligns with the 2% goal, signalling a cautious stance.
highlights: Decision split 8‑1 with Hajime Takata dissenting, urging a rise to 1.5%
Core‑core inflation forecast lifted to 2.7% for FY2027, excluding fresh food and energy

msft_25bn_debt_2026_10_30.headline: Microsoft to Issue $25 Billion of Bonds for AI Infrastructure Expansion
msft_25bn_debt_2026_10_30.summary: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in bonds, leveraging its AAA rating to fund AI lab demand, capital spending, acquisitions and other corporate needs.
highlights: Targeting $170 billion in 2026 capital expenditures.
Offerings expected to close on Nov. 4.
Microsoft reported positive free cash flow, unlike Alphabet and Meta.

aws_39pct_rev_growth_2026_10_30.headline: Amazon AWS Posts 39% Revenue Surge as Cloud Rivals Accelerate
aws_39pct_rev_growth_2026_10_30.summary: AWS reported $45.98 billion revenue, a 39% year‑over‑year rise, while rivals Alphabet and Microsoft also accelerated cloud growth amid AI demand.
highlights: AWS operating income jumped 55% to $17.77 billion.
AWS now represents nearly 23% of Amazon’s total revenue, a record share.

unit_1_begins_generating_power_uses_elec.headline: Bangladesh’s Rooppur Unit 1 Starts Power Start‑Up, Uses Electricity Internally
unit_1_begins_generating_power_uses_elec.summary: Unit 1 of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant began power start‑up operations, currently feeding electricity to its own systems while awaiting certification to join the national grid.
highlights: Unit 1 commenced power start‑up after BAERA approval
Turbine checks continue as output rises toward 300 MW target
Certification D and grid connection expected within 15‑20 days

bangladesh_japan_discuss_alternative_fin.headline: Bangladesh and Japan Explore Alternative Financing to Boost Infrastructure
bangladesh_japan_discuss_alternative_fin.summary: Bangladesh’s finance minister and his Japanese counterpart discussed expanding economic cooperation through non‑FDI financing, targeting infrastructure projects and trade growth.
highlights: Both finance ministers met in Tokyo to discuss alternative financing mechanisms.
Japan has previously funded major infrastructure and social projects in Bangladesh.
Officials agreed to pursue new sectors and dynamic initiatives beyond traditional FDI.

bangladesh_seeks_lower_thai_tariffs_high.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Trade Division
bangladesh_seeks_lower_thai_tariffs_high.headline: Bangladesh Urges Thailand to Cut Tariffs and Boost Pharma, Jute Exports
bangladesh_seeks_lower_thai_tariffs_high.summary: Bangladesh asked Thailand to lower import duties and increase purchases of Bangladeshi pharmaceuticals and jute, while nations prepared for early FTA talks and a new direct shipping route.
highlights: Thailand signaled willingness to consider Bangladesh’s tariff reduction proposals and start FTA negotiations.
The new direct shipping service cuts transit time between Chattogram and Ranong from 15 days to four days.

stock_drop.headline: Alphabet Shares Plunge 13%, Erasing $500 Billion in Market Value
stock_drop.summary: Alphabet reported a $9.07 billion free‑cash‑flow loss and missed earnings expectations, triggering a 13% stock drop that wiped out about $500 billion in value.
highlights: Search advertising revenue grew 12% to $63.35 billion but fell short of forecasts.
Microsoft’s capital spending rose 30% YoY to $45.2 billion, yet missed analyst targets.

ai_spending_legacy.headline: Tech Giants Rely on Legacy Businesses as AI Spending Swallows Cash
ai_spending_legacy.summary: Tech megacaps are funding massive AI infrastructure projects with cash from advertising, software and e‑commerce units, but rising interest rates threaten their free‑cash flow.
highlights: Meta posted a $2.12 billion negative free cash flow, Amazon $42.4 billion, and Alphabet $9.07 billion this quarter
Microsoft remains the only hyperscaler with positive free cash flow, generating $18.63 billion despite a 27% decline
Amazon forecasts capital expenditures of $220 billion this year, potentially exceeding $280 billion next year

garment_exporters_accuse_local_yarn_mill.headline: Bangladesh Garment Exporters Blame Local Yarn Mills for Price Surge
garment_exporters_accuse_local_yarn_mill.summary: Garment makers claim domestic yarn prices have risen up to 19% versus Indian yarn after duty‑free import restrictions, increasing production costs and threatening viability.
highlights: Local yarn prices are about 6% higher per kilogram since the September restrictions.
BKMEA reports the price gap with Indian yarn widened from 9% to nearly 19% by October.

hilsa_catches_surge_as_fishing_resumes_i.headline: Hilsa Catches Surge as 22‑Day Ban Ends in Bangladesh
hilsa_catches_surge_as_fishing_resumes_i.summary: Following the lift of the 22‑day ban, coastal fishermen report strong hilsa catches, though many fish still contain eggs, boosting local supply.
highlights: Around 500,000 fishermen returned to rivers after the ban, with 425,009 registered in six coastal districts.
Bhola district produced 179,300 metric tonnes of hilsa last year and expects higher output this season.
An eight‑month nationwide ban on juvenile hilsa (jatka) starts Nov 1, lasting until June 30 2027.

egg_prices_rise_tk10_a_dozen_winter_vege.headline: Egg Prices Jump Tk10 per Dozen as Winter Veggies Stay High
egg_prices_rise_tk10_a_dozen_winter_vege.summary: Eggs now cost Tk150 for brown and Tk140 for white, while winter vegetables like potatoes and tomatoes remain pricey despite increased market arrivals.
highlights: Egg prices rose by Tk10 per dozen across Dhaka markets.
Fish prices also increased, with rui up Tk20 per kg.
Chicken prices stayed stable, broiler at Tk180‑190 per kg.

hormuz_oil_flow_disruption.headline: Tankers Keep Crude Flowing Through Hormuz Amid Surge in Iranian Attacks
hormuz_oil_flow_disruption.summary: Despite a sharp rise in Iranian attacks, tanker crews and U.S. military protection have kept crude exports near pre‑war levels through the Strait of Hormuz.
highlights: Crude exports fell 90% in March but recovered to about 11.1 million bpd in October.
Super‑tanker day rates jumped from $249,000 to over $900,000, raising freight costs to $21 per barrel.

i_bond_rate_5_51.headline: Treasury Sets Series I Bond Rate at 5.51% Through April
i_bond_rate_5_51.summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a 5.51% annual interest rate for new Series I bonds from November to April, combining a 4.08% inflation-linked component with a 1.40% fixed rate.
highlights: Variable portion rises to 4.08% based on CPI inflation
Fixed portion increases to 1.40%, highest since 2006

oil_earnings_q3_2026.headline: Chevron and Exxon Post Record Refining Profits Amid Diesel Surge
oil_earnings_q3_2026.summary: U.S. refineries ran near full capacity, driving Chevron and Exxon earnings to record highs as diesel prices spiked over 70% year‑over‑year.
highlights: Exxon’s adjusted earnings reached $4.23 per share, beating expectations of $4.08.
Chevron’s refining division profit jumped more than 300% to $4.9 billion.

loan_deal_450m.headline: Bangladesh Secures $450 Million World Bank Loan to Bolster Financial Sector
loan_deal_450m.summary: Bangladesh and the World Bank have signed a $450 million loan agreement to strengthen the financial safety net, supervisory capacity, and banking restructuring over a 25‑year term.
highlights: The loan carries a 1.5% interest rate on withdrawn balances and up to 0.50% commitment fee on unwithdrawn balances, though the
The loan matures over 25 years with a five‑year grace period, funding the Financial Sector Support project II from July 2026 to

gold_price_cut.headline: Bangladesh Gold Prices Drop Tk5,481 per Bhori for 22-Carat
gold_price_cut.summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association announced a new 22‑carat gold price of Tk217,592 per bhori, cutting Tk5,481 after a recent market decline.
highlights: 21‑carat gold now costs Tk207,794 per bhori, down Tk5,249
18‑carat gold price falls to Tk178,459 per bhori, a Tk4,491 reduction

ai_pc_market.headline: AI‑Driven Chip Shortage Pushes Bangladeshi PC Prices to Record Highs
ai_pc_market.summary: Rising demand for AI memory chips has caused RAM, SSD and graphics card costs to double, leaving ordinary Bangladeshis unable to afford new PCs.
highlights: DDR5 RAM prices have risen up to four‑fold since July 2025, reaching Tk31,000–35,000 per stick.
Graphics cards that cost Tk40,000–45,000 a year ago now sell for over Tk60,000, a 30‑40% increase.
PC sales at Dhaka’s IDB market fell from over 20 units daily to just four‑five units.

record_hack_6_3bn.headline: Binance Hack Hits $6.3 Billion, Exchange Promises Full Customer Compensation
record_hack_6_3bn.summary: A record $6.3 billion theft from Binance’s wallets has frozen half the assets, while the exchange taps its $1 billion SAFU fund and additional reserves to reimburse users.
highlights: Approximately $6.3 billion in client assets were stolen, with about $3 billion currently frozen on blockchain networks.
Binance will cover losses using its $1 billion SAFU emergency reserve and has set aside over $6.3 billion of its own funds.

stock_plunge_govt_stake.headline: Intel shares tumble 29%, erasing $12 billion government stake
stock_plunge_govt_stake.summary: Intel's 29% plunge, driven by weaker guidance and an Israeli plant shutdown, wiped roughly $12 billion off the U.S. government's 10% stake.
highlights: CEO Lip‑Bu Tan, hired in March 2025, faces a setback as Intel misses AI‑boom expectations
Analysts cut Intel to neutral as PC shipments fell 4% YoY and revenue guidance fell short of estimates
Nvidia’s stake in Intel lost about $6 billion as the chipmaker’s stock fell

sq_cables_marks_15_years_with_expansion_.headline: SQ Cables Expands into High‑Voltage and Submarine Production at Mirsarai SEZ
sq_cables_marks_15_years_with_expansion_.summary: SQ Group celebrates 15 years in cables by launching high‑voltage and submarine cable manufacturing at its Mirsarai industrial park, boosting domestic capacity and export potential.
highlights: Production includes cables up to 33 kV and ocean submarine lines
The SEZ location offers world‑class infrastructure and policy incentives

bangladesh_did_not_need_to_import_onions.headline: Bangladesh Eliminates Onion Imports with New Gamma Irradiation Centre
bangladesh_did_not_need_to_import_onions.summary: Agriculture Minister Mohammad Amin Ur Rashid announced that modern gamma irradiation facilities will prevent spoilage and ensure safety, removing the need for onion imports this year.
highlights: The 500,000‑curie gamma irradiation centre was inaugurated at BINA’s regional research centre in Gazipur.
The centre can destroy harmful microorganisms, extend shelf life and reduce spoilage of onions, potatoes and fruits.
China Isotope and Radiation Corporation won the EPC contract, marking its first major project in Bangladesh.

shipping_agent_disputes_reports_of_aflat.headline: Seven Seas Shipping Disputes Aflatoxin Claims in Imported Indian Rice
shipping_agent_disputes_reports_of_aflat.summary: Seven Seas Shipping Lines says 135 tonnes of rice held for quality checks contain no harmful aflatoxin, after DG Food and BRRI tests showed levels below safety limits.
highlights: 135 tonnes of rice were segregated pending final quality clearance
DG Food and BRRI tests found aflatoxin levels below the laboratory's quantifiable limit
The vessel MV HT Pioneer arrived with 10,878 tonnes of rice from Kolkata

fed_officials_hiking_rates_signal.headline: Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes Ahead Amid Persistent Inflation
fed_officials_hiking_rates_signal.summary: Two Fed presidents warned that additional quarter-point hikes are likely soon, emphasizing that inflation remains above target and urging proactive monetary tightening.
highlights: Mus​alem expects a rate hike soon, citing 3.4% GDP growth and a resilient labor market
Logan predicts at least two more 25‑basis‑point increases before a possible pause

city_bank_s_q3_profit_drops_19_on_lower_.headline: City Bank Q3 Profit Falls 19% Amid Lower Investment Income
city_bank_s_q3_profit_drops_19_on_lower_.summary: City Bank PLC's Q3 2026 net profit dropped 19% year‑on‑year to Tk341 crore, driven by reduced investment income and higher operating expenses.
highlights: Investment income fell to Tk1,082.34 crore, down from Tk1,110.54 crore a year earlier
Operating expenses rose to Tk636.68 crore, up from Tk535.35 crore

tk30_000_wage_demand_rmg_workers_block_m.headline: RMG Workers Demand Tk30,000 Wage, Block Roads in Dhaka
tk30_000_wage_demand_rmg_workers_block_m.summary: Garment workers in Ashulia, Mirpur and Gazipur staged protests demanding a Tk30,000 minimum wage, causing factory holidays and severe traffic disruptions across the capital region.
highlights: At least 43 factories in Ashulia and Gazipur declared holidays
Clashes in Gazipur created a 15‑km traffic jam
A police officer was injured after being hit by a brick in Ashulia

brokers_seek_capital_gains_tax_exemption.headline: Bangladesh Brokers Push Full Capital Gains Tax Exemption Until 2030
brokers_seek_capital_gains_tax_exemption.summary: The DSE Brokers Association of Bangladesh urged the finance ministry to reinstate a capital gains tax exemption for individual and foreign investors through 2030 to boost market liquidity.
highlights: Current exemption applies only up to Tk50 lakh, with excess gains taxed at 15%.
Proposal seeks exemption until 2030 and review of foreign investor tax framework.

crypto_political_spending_200_m.headline: Crypto Industry Pumps Over $200 Million Into 2026 Midterms
crypto_political_spending_200_m.summary: The crypto sector is spending more than $200 million on House and Senate races to secure lawmakers supportive of favorable digital‑asset regulations.
highlights: Fairshake and affiliated super PACs back 33 House candidates, injecting $1 million each into six incumbents
Coinbase contributed $25 million to Fairshake’s 2025 effort and CEO Brian Armstrong gave a personal $1 million donation

pop_up_super_pacs_637_m.headline: Pop‑up Super PACs Dump $637 Million into 2026 Midterm Races
pop_up_super_pacs_637_m.summary: Late‑forming super PACs, many linked to major party networks, have spent $637 million on congressional races, exploiting delayed donor disclosure to influence the 2026 midterms.
highlights: 22 super PACs formed within ten weeks of Election Day each spent at least $1 million, accounting for over 22% of independent
Republican‑linked PACs like No Going Back and Texas PAC alone contributed roughly two‑thirds of the $637 million total.

berkshire_stock_rally_stalls.headline: Berkshire Hits New Record Highs Amid AI Stock Pullback
berkshire_stock_rally_stalls.summary: Berkshire Hathaway’s Class A and B shares reached fresh all‑time highs as investors rotate from high‑flying AI stocks toward the conglomerate’s steady earnings.
highlights: Class A closed at $815,600, up 0.3% for the week
Alphabet stake fell to $29.6 billion, a quarter‑value loss since August

rooftop_solar_tax_benefits.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
rooftop_solar_tax_benefits.headline: Bangladesh Grants ‘Green House’ Status and Tax Incentives for Rooftop Solar Homes
rooftop_solar_tax_benefits.summary: The government will soon pass legislation recognizing rooftop solar households as ‘green houses’ and offering tax breaks to boost renewable energy adoption.
highlights: Law to be passed soon to facilitate rooftop solar installations
Target of 5,000 megawatts renewable generation within six months
Tax incentives for households installing solar panels

firms_skip_dividends_fy26.headline: Bangladesh Firms Skip FY26 Dividends Amid Heavy Losses and Downgrades
firms_skip_dividends_fy26.summary: Twenty‑three listed companies, including Zeal Bangla Sugar Mills and Meghna Cement, announced no FY26 dividends as losses surge and four firms fall to the DSE Z category.
highlights: 23 companies withheld dividends, with Zeal Bangla Sugar Mills reporting a Tk72.32 loss per share.
Four firms—Bangladesh Building Systems, Information Services Network, Investment Corporation of Bangladesh, Deshbandhu

japan_visit_agreements.headline: Bangladesh-Japan Summit Raises Questions Over Loan Terms and Manpower Claims
japan_visit_agreements.summary: Opposition demands transparency on $295.5 million loans, $6.3 billion investment talks, and disputed worker recruitment figures following the prime minister’s Japan visit.
highlights: $295.5 million loan commitments and $6.3 billion private sector investment discussed
Government signed four government‑level instruments, including a MoC, but many MOUs are private‑sector only
Japan denied reports of a 100,000 annual worker recruitment agreement

openai_fundraise_20bn_2026_11_01.headline: OpenAI trims fundraising target to $20 billion, eyes $1.25 trillion valuation
openai_fundraise_20bn_2026_11_01.summary: OpenAI has reduced its latest funding round goal to up to $20 billion, aiming for a post‑money valuation of $1.25 trillion amid cautious investor commitments.
highlights: Funding round target cut by $10 billion from earlier $30 billion plan
United Arab Emirates investors and Coatue are leading the round
AI‑related stocks fell sharply as big‑tech AI spending came under scrutiny

automatic_401k_rollovers_2026_10_31.headline: Automatic 401(k) Portability Cuts Cash-Outs but Few Transfers Reach New Plans
automatic_401k_rollovers_2026_10_31.summary: Vanguard's study shows the Portability Services Network lowered cash-outs for small 401(k) balances, yet only a handful of rolled‑over accounts have reached a new employer’s plan.
highlights: Cash‑out rates fell from about 50% to 9% for balances under $1,000 after employers joined the network.
Only 6% of accounts transferred to interim IRAs successfully moved into a new employer’s 401(k) by early 2026.
The network has processed 53,118 transactions, moving $71.3 million to new plans.

qr_p2p.headline: Bangladesh Bank launches Bangla QR-based P2P payment service
qr_p2p.summary: Bangladesh Bank's new QR‑based P2P service lets users transfer funds by scanning a Bangla QR code, removing the need for manual mobile or account entry.
highlights: Users transfer money by scanning the recipient's Bangla QR code
The service aims to make digital transfers faster, safer and reduce cash reliance
Assistant spokesperson Shahriar Siddique confirmed the launch

ai_cyber_policy.headline: Bangladesh Bank to Roll Out AI‑Based Cybersecurity Policy for Financial Sector
ai_cyber_policy.summary: Bangladesh Bank will soon issue an AI‑driven cybersecurity policy that mandates banks and financial institutions to upgrade IT defenses, improve threat detection, and enforce continuous monitoring.
highlights: The Cybersecurity Framework Version 1.0 sets a Dec 31 2026 deadline for implementation.
A recent PHP vulnerability prompted Bangladesh Bank to temporarily shut down its website as a precaution.

denmark_invest_coop.headline: Denmark seeks to boost investment in Bangladesh infrastructure and energy
denmark_invest_coop.summary: Bangladesh and Denmark discussed expanding bilateral FDI, forming a joint team for the Laldiya Container Terminal and exploring Danish expertise in energy and food processing sectors.
highlights: Joint working team proposed to expedite the Laldiya Container Terminal project with APM Terminals
KAFCO identified as a key investment target for Danish partners
Food processing opportunities highlighted for northern Bangladesh regions

fed_put_discussion.headline: Fed Put Returns as policymakers eye bond‑market coordination amid steady rates
fed_put_discussion.summary: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged while inflation stays sticky, prompting strategists to anticipate a renewed Fed put and tighter Treasury‑Fed collaboration.
highlights: Fed left policy rates unchanged despite oil‑driven inflation above $100 per barrel
Strategists expect coordinated Fed‑Treasury bond purchases to provide market liquidity in 2027
Tech sector led recent sell‑off while Healthcare, Financial Services and Real Estate posted gains

midterm_muni_impact.headline: Midterm Election May Reshape Municipal Bond Market Amid Tax and Supply Shifts
midterm_muni_impact.summary: State-level tax proposals and new debt authorizations in the November vote could alter muni bond yields, pricing and credit risk as investors reassess supply and demand dynamics.
highlights: Blue states propose higher income taxes, while red states aim to cut property taxes, affecting muni tax exemption value.
Issuance to date tops $473.8 billion, a 7.8% year‑over‑year rise, raising supply concerns.
Analysts suggest AA‑rated or higher munis remain attractive for investors in the 24%+ tax bracket.

rmg_owners_to_close_factories_temporaril.headline: Bangladesh Garment Owners Threaten Temporary Factory Closures Over Worker Strikes
rmg_owners_to_close_factories_temporaril.summary: Following the formation of a new wage board, BGMEA warned that 529 garment factories will shut down temporarily under Section 13(1) if workers continue striking.
highlights: 529 factories halted production on Sunday due to workers not reporting.
Workers demand a minimum monthly wage of Tk30,000, up from the current Tk12,500.
Section 13(1) of the Bangladesh Labour Act permits temporary closure during illegal strikes.

wage_board_formed_minister_urges_protest.headline: Bangladesh Forms Wage Board as RMG Workers Demand Tk30,000 Minimum Wage
wage_board_formed_minister_urges_protest.summary: The government created a six‑member wage board to review RMG wages amid protests demanding a Tk30,000 monthly minimum, while ministers blame political instigation.
highlights: Board chaired by Sheikh Ashfaqul Rahman includes neutral member Mosleh Uddin Ahmed and employer reps from Bangladesh Employers
Last wage revision in 2023 set minimum at Tk12,500; current protests seek Tk30,000
Police used tear gas in Mirpur and Border Guard Bangladesh deployed in Gazipur amid unrest

wage_review_comes_amid_mounting_pressure.headline: Bangladesh forms wage board amid RMG worker protests
wage_review_comes_amid_mounting_pressure.summary: Garment workers demand a Tk30,000 minimum wage as inflation outpaces wage growth, prompting the government to establish a wage board to review RMG wages.
highlights: Last wage revision in 2023 raised the minimum to Tk12,500.
Real wages have fallen for 56 consecutive months, with inflation above 8% since August 2022.

cnbc.com/2026/11/01/alaska-senate-doj-la.headline: Judge Dismisses DOJ Lawsuit Over Alaska Senate Ballot Confusion
cnbc.com/2026/11/01/alaska-senate-doj-la.summary: A federal judge ruled the Justice Department lacked standing to delay Alaska’s Senate certification, rejecting claims that duplicate Dan Sullivan candidates would mislead voters.
highlights: The decision comes days before the election, preserving the ranked‑choice contest between incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan and
DOJ announced it will appeal, arguing the candidate was a “decoy” intended to confuse voters.

cnbc.com/2026/11/01/michigan-senate-stev.headline: Democratic Rep. Stevens Switches Support to Republican Rogers in Michigan Senate Race
highlights: Stevens previously backed El‑Sayed and lost the primary to him
The endorsement highlights a split in Democratic ranks over U.S. support for Israel
Senate control hinges on the Michigan race as Republicans aim to flip the seat

cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/11/01/3-big-.headline: Midterm Elections, Earnings and Jobs Drive Market Outlook This Week
cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/11/01/3-big-.summary: Investors will watch Apple’s earnings, the October nonfarm payrolls, and the midterm results for clues on Fed policy, AI buildout and equity momentum.
highlights: Apple reports earnings Monday; analysts focus on margin trends and services revenue.
October nonfarm payrolls expected to add 75,000 jobs, with unemployment at 4.2%.
Midterm elections could shift control of the House and Senate, affecting AI‑related policy.

ipdc_finance_plans_to_raise_tk400cr_thru.headline: IPDC Finance to Raise Tk400 crore via Subordinated and Green Zero‑Coupon Bonds
ipdc_finance_plans_to_raise_tk400cr_thru.summary: IPDC Finance plans a Tk200 crore unsecured subordinated bond and a Tk200 crore green zero‑coupon bond to boost Tier‑II capital and meet financing needs.
highlights: The six‑year subordinated bond and five‑year green bond require approval from Bangladesh Bank and Bangladesh Securities and
IPDC reported a 35% rise in net profit to Tk35.4 crore in the first nine months of 2026.

confidence_cement_exits_battery_business.headline: Confidence Cement sells Confidence Batteries stake for Tk11.34 crore
confidence_cement_exits_battery_business.summary: Confidence Cement approved the sale of its 1.03 crore shares in Confidence Batteries to Confidence Infrastructure for Tk11.34 crore to meet immediate financial obligations.
highlights: Share price fell 2.10% to Tk56 after the announcement.
Earnings per share dropped to Tk10.20 while net asset value per share rose to Tk96.89.

corporate_earnings_gloom_drags_dsex_down.headline: Corporate earnings gloom drags DSEX lower for second day
corporate_earnings_gloom_drags_dsex_down.summary: The DSEX fell 0.60% to 5,385.15 as weak earnings, dividend cuts and broader economic headwinds dampened investor sentiment, while market turnover dropped 14.6%.
highlights: Blue‑chip DS30 index slipped 0.88% to 2,068.43 points
Jute sector recorded the steepest decline of 5.5%

hackoutflows.headline: Binance Records $3.64 Billion Net Outflows After Hack‑Triggered Withdrawals Resume
hackoutflows.summary: Following the $6.3 billion hack, Binance processed $4.65 billion in withdrawals, resulting in $3.64 billion net outflows, about 2.1% of its assets.
highlights: Withdrawals peaked within hours of reopening and then began stabilizing.
Circle froze over $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the breach.
Binance covered roughly 95% of the stolen funds, leaving 5% in less liquid tokens.

aimodelbudget.headline: South Korea Unveils Record AI‑Focused Budget Aiming for World‑Best Model
aimodelbudget.summary: President Lee Jae Myung announced a 12.8% budget increase to 820.9 trillion won, allocating 4.7 trillion won for a sovereign AI model and doubling AI‑related spending.
highlights: AI and semiconductor spending will rise to 21.3 trillion won, nearly double 2026 levels.
Defense budget climbs 8.2% to 73.3 trillion won, funding AI‑driven hybrid systems.

nbr_split_plan_back_on_the_table.headline: Bangladesh Revives NBR Split Plan Ahead of IMF Loan Conditions
nbr_split_plan_back_on_the_table.summary: The government will reintroduce a bill to divide the National Board of Revenue into implementation and policy divisions, a reform required for the IMF’s $5.5 bn loan.
highlights: Revenue Implementation Division will be led by a secretary‑rank chairman and other secretaries from within NBR.
Revenue Policy Division head will be a general cadre officer, supported by economists, chartered accountants and legal experts.
The split is a key condition of the IMF’s $5.5 bn loan programme to improve Bangladesh’s low tax‑to‑GDP ratio.

bankers_propose_easing_nid_requirement_f.headline: Bangladesh bankers push to relax NID rule for expatriate accounts
bankers_propose_easing_nid_requirement_f.summary: Bank directors urged Bangladesh Bank to replace NID with passport for Non‑Resident Taka Accounts and raise the Tk 10 lakh loan ceiling to boost expatriate participation.
highlights: Bankers proposed a digital account opening system modeled on Pakistan’s Roshan Digital Account.
Bangladesh Bank’s June circular already permits loans against deposits, except for agriculture, forestry and housing.

third_terminal_deal_may_tie_bangladesh_s.headline: Bangladesh Accepts 15‑Year No‑Compete Clause in HSIA Third Terminal Deal
third_terminal_deal_may_tie_bangladesh_s.summary: Bangladesh approved a concession with a Japanese consortium that includes a 15‑year ban on competing commercial airports within 100 km of Dhaka, while securing a 27% revenue share.
highlights: Bangladesh will receive 27% of relevant concession revenue, with a reduced rate during partial operations
The agreement also addresses revenue sharing, Biman Bangladesh Airlines’ contractual status, and construction‑defect liability

oracle_files_to_sell_20_bn_in_new_stock_.headline: Oracle launches $20 billion stock and bond offering to fund AI expansion
oracle_files_to_sell_20_bn_in_new_stock_.summary: Oracle plans to raise $10 billion each through common stock and senior notes, using proceeds for capital spending, debt repayment and AI infrastructure investments.
highlights: Shares fell over 6% after filing despite prior investor‑day optimism
Oracle’s credit rating was downgraded to BBB‑, with its 2028 free‑cash‑flow target tied to vendor financing and prepayments

fed_to_vote_on_rates_less_often_impact_o.headline: Fed Reduces Rate‑Setting Votes, Extending Borrowers’ Cost Uncertainty
fed_to_vote_on_rates_less_often_impact_o.summary: By cutting scheduled interest‑rate votes to six per year, the Federal Reserve may delay relief for consumers facing elevated credit‑card, mortgage and auto loan costs.
highlights: Fed will hold eight meetings in 2026 but only six will include rate votes after 2027
Credit‑card rates tied to the prime rate may keep rising despite the Fed’s steady benchmark
Lenders can adjust rates independently, so borrowers could face prolonged high costs

home_minister_reopen_factories.headline: Home Minister Announces Plans to Reopen Closed RMG Factories Soon
home_minister_reopen_factories.summary: Minister Salahuddin Ahmed pledged swift government action to restart halted garment production, noting the Wage Board will set a new minimum wage reflecting current economic conditions.
highlights: Government will take steps to reopen closed RMG factories
Wage Board has begun work to determine minimum wage based on prevailing economic realities
Minister warned protests are politically motivated and will be dealt with firmly

cases_filed_ashulia_protests.headline: Garment Worker Protests in Ashulia Lead to Two Cases and Twelve Arrests
cases_filed_ashulia_protests.summary: Authorities filed two police cases over alleged unrest, vandalism and sabotage during recent garment worker demonstrations in Ashulia, resulting in the arrest of twelve individuals.
highlights: Two cases name 1,000 unidentified accused
Police arrested three people from Ashulia and nine from Savar

helmet_brigade_concerns.headline: BNP Calls for Vigilance Amid Garment Workers' Unrest and Helmet Brigade Infiltration
helmet_brigade_concerns.summary: Local BNP leaders claim outsiders and a masked helmet brigade are exploiting RMG wage protests in Savar, urging activists to stay on the ground with police.
highlights: BNP lawmakers allege a banned Awami League is using the protests to create instability
Police asked BNP activists to station themselves at key points across the industrial area
Garment sector wage board announced higher minimum wages but demonstrations continue

australia_hikes_rates_to_18_year_high_to.headline: Australia Raises Cash Rate to 4.85%, Highest Since 2008
australia_hikes_rates_to_18_year_high_to.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia lifted its benchmark cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85%, aiming to curb inflation that remains above target through 2027.
highlights: Rate increased to 4.85%, the highest level since November 2008.
CPI rose to 4.3% in September, the strongest since March.
RBA governor Michelle Bullock warned of upside inflation risks from oil prices and AI‑driven tech costs.

openai_hires_former_u_s_army_secretary_d.headline: OpenAI appoints former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to lead national security AI efforts
openai_hires_former_u_s_army_secretary_d.summary: OpenAI hired ex‑U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as senior counselor to guide AI‑driven modernization of U.S. national security and allied adoption of democratic AI.
highlights: Driscoll will work with OpenAI leadership and external partners to integrate AI into U.S. security and cyber resilience
The role focuses on helping allies adopt advanced AI responsibly under the “democratic AI” framework
OpenAI’s Daybreak program aims to protect essential services through AI‑enhanced cyber resilience

palantir_reports_booming_u_s_commercial_.headline: Palantir Surpasses Government Revenue as U.S. Commercial AI Sales Soar
palantir_reports_booming_u_s_commercial_.summary: Palantir posted $2.31 billion Q3 revenue, with U.S. commercial earnings jumping 148% to $984 million, overtaking its government segment for the first time.
highlights: Net income rose to $1.13 billion, more than doubling year‑over‑year.
Full‑year guidance lifted to over $3.56 billion in U.S. commercial revenue.

tbsnews.net/economy/stocks/nine-pharma-f.headline: Bangladesh Pharma Sector Shows Mixed Profit Growth, ACI and Silva Losses Widen
tbsnews.net/economy/stocks/nine-pharma-f.summary: Nine listed pharmaceutical firms doubled earnings in FY26 while ACI and Silva reported wider losses, highlighting the sector’s reliance on imported APIs.
highlights: Asiatic Laboratories and Beacon Pharmaceuticals more than doubled profits, reaching Tk57.28 crore and Tk194 crore respectively
ACI and Silva Pharmaceuticals saw losses expand to Tk75.46 crore and Tk16.27 crore
Over 85% of active pharmaceutical ingredients are imported, making the sector vulnerable to exchange‑rate swings

tbsnews.net/economy/stocks/t-shirts-expo.headline: Scandex Files Tk55 crore IPO as Bangladesh Garment Market Revives
tbsnews.net/economy/stocks/t-shirts-expo.summary: The T‑shirt maker Scandex (BD) seeks Tk55 crore through a Tk13 per share IPO to fund factory expansion, marking the first export‑oriented garment IPO in seven years.
highlights: Scandex aims to raise Tk55 crore at Tk13 per share, offering a Tk3 premium over face value.
The company’s production grew to 1.70 crore pieces in 2026, up from 35 lakh in 2019.
Six firms together target Tk612 crore in IPOs, with Confidence Power seeking Tk400 crore for solar projects.

tbsnews.net/economy/bangladesh-bank-waiv.headline: Bangladesh Bank Waives Prior Approval for Up to 5% Foreign Dividend
tbsnews.net/economy/bangladesh-bank-waiv.summary: Bangladesh Bank now permits resident manufacturers and service firms to issue preference shares to non‑resident investors without prior approval for dividends up to 5% of face value.
highlights: Preference shares can be issued against foreign currency remitted through official channels.
Dividends above 5% require prior Bangladesh Bank approval.
Redemption proceeds must be remitted via the same AD bank that received the original investment.

cnbc.com/2026/11/03/oil-prices-climb-aft.headline: Oil Prices Slip as US‑Iran Diplomacy Hopes Ease Conflict Risks
cnbc.com/2026/11/03/oil-prices-climb-aft.summary: Crude oil futures fell for a day, with West Texas Intermediate at $95.83 and Brent at $103.18, as talks mediated by Qatar raise hopes of a US‑Iran settlement.
highlights: West Texas Intermediate futures dropped 63 cents to $95.83 per barrel.
Brent crude fell $1.59 to $103.18 per barrel.

cnbc.com/2026/11/03/bill-ackman-casino-s.headline: Ackman warns stock market has become a leveraged casino
cnbc.com/2026/11/03/bill-ackman-casino-s.summary: Bill Ackman cautioned that soaring speculative trading and 95% leverage are turning equity markets into a casino, risking investors and the broader economy.
highlights: Ackman said markets are trading at prices that “make no sense” due to high leverage.
Pershing Square bought Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet after sharp drops linked to the SaaSpocalypse, tariffs and ChatGPT launch.
He highlighted Visa, Mastercard and Netflix as top long‑term picks.

cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/11/03/were-t.headline: Jim Cramer's Trust Sells DuPont Shares After Strong Earnings Surge
cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/11/03/were-t.summary: DuPont's earnings beat expectations, prompting Jim Cramer's Charitable Trust to trim its holding while the stock climbs toward $154.
highlights: DuPont reported organic sales growth of 5% YoY and EPS of $2.09, beating estimates
The Trust reduced its position to about 1.5% of the portfolio, selling 50 shares at $147
Shares rose roughly 4% after the earnings release, reaching as high as $154

circular_preference_shares_dividends.headline: Bangladesh Bank Waives Prior Approval for Up to 5% Preference Share Dividends
circular_preference_shares_dividends.summary: Bangladesh Bank now permits manufacturers and service firms to issue preference shares to non‑resident investors with dividend rates up to 5% without prior approval, streamlining foreign capital flows.
highlights: Preference shares can be issued only against foreign currency remitted through official banking channels
Dividends above 5% require prior Bangladesh Bank approval
Redemption proceeds must be sent back via the same AD bank within 30 days

wage_board_meeting.headline: Bangladesh Wage Board to Meet Soon on New RMG Minimum Wage
wage_board_meeting.summary: Chairman Sheikh Ashfaqur Rahman announced the board will convene shortly to fast‑track a new wage structure for RMG workers amid ongoing labour unrest.
highlights: The board includes representatives from employers, workers, and the garment industry, chaired by Senior District Judge Ashfaqur
The last minimum wage of Tk12,500 took effect in December 2023 and is due for revision after three years.
Previous wage revisions took six to seven months; the government pledges a much faster process this time.

rmg_factories_reopen_request.headline: Bangladesh RMG Owners Reopen Factories Amid Government Appeal
rmg_factories_reopen_request.summary: RMG factory owners have reopened plants today following a government request, while a new wage board meets and labour unrest persists across key industrial zones.
highlights: Factories will stay open but can be shut under Section 13(1) of the Labour Act if unrest continues
The newly formed wage board may announce a new minimum wage by December
International buyers are cutting orders by up to 20% amid delivery concerns

binance_breach_puts_custody_at_center_of.headline: Binance Hack Highlights Custody’s Growing Role in Crypto Infrastructure
binance_breach_puts_custody_at_center_of.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance breach underscores investors’ shift toward valuing custodial security and infrastructure over trading volume in the crypto sector.
highlights: Binance replenished 98% of the stolen $6.34 billion within days.
Tether, Circle and Ripple froze about $3 billion of the stolen assets.

amd_stock_jumps_8_on_earnings_as_data_ce.headline: AMD Shares Surge 8% as Data‑Center Revenue Nearly Doubles
amd_stock_jumps_8_on_earnings_as_data_ce.summary: AMD reported a 45% revenue jump and almost double data‑center sales, driving an 8% post‑market stock rise and reinforcing its AI‑chip leadership.
highlights: Revenue reached $13.38 billion, beating estimates, with data‑center accounting for 64% of sales.
AMD announced a $1 billion investment in Meta’s equity offering and up to $5 billion in Anthropic.

amd_has_been_crushed_into_earnings_here_.headline: AMD Slides After Tech Earnings, Options Strategy Offers Neutral Play
amd_has_been_crushed_into_earnings_here_.summary: AMD fell sharply as tech earnings disappointed, but traders can use a November 4 put‑call spread to capture elevated implied volatility without betting on direction.
highlights: AMD dropped 10.9% after Intel’s weak guidance and continued falling 7.5% Monday.
The proposed spread sells a 425/415 put and a 510/520 call for a $3.65 credit, targeting a 9% move.

capm_ibbl_mutual_fund_unit_price_drops_9.headline: Islami Bank to Sell 20 Lakh Units of CAPM IBBL Mutual Fund
capm_ibbl_mutual_fund_unit_price_drops_9.summary: Islami Bank PLC will sell 20 lakh units of the CAPM IBBL Mutual Fund on the DSE within 30 days as the fund’s price fell 9.46% to Tk13.40.
highlights: Unit price dropped to Tk13.40, a 9.46% decline
Bank plans to off‑load 20 lakh units within 30 working days
Fund’s NAV stands at Tk7.79 per unit at market price

statement_on_avoiding_excessive_debt_in_.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
statement_on_avoiding_excessive_debt_in_.headline: Bangladesh Targets 20% Renewable Power by 2030, Calls for Debt‑Safe Energy Strategy
statement_on_avoiding_excessive_debt_in_.summary: State Minister Shama Obaed Islam urged transparent, coordinated investment to meet renewable electricity goals while avoiding excessive debt and reducing reliance on imported fossil fuels.
highlights: Renewable electricity target set at 20% by 2030 and 30% by 2040.
Proposal to allocate at least 1.5% of total bank lending to renewable projects, aiming for 15‑20% green finance by 2030.
Encouragement of private‑public rooftop solar partnerships and expanded commercial bank financing for roughly 8,500 renewable

bangladesh_malaysia_joint_monitoring_for.headline: Bangladesh and Malaysia Agree Joint Monitoring for Fair Recruitment
bangladesh_malaysia_joint_monitoring_for.summary: Bangladesh and Malaysia discussed joint inspections to ensure transparent recruitment of Bangladeshi workers while advancing a free trade agreement and broader economic ties.
highlights: Joint inspections will monitor the migration system for fairness and transparency
Both sides aim to conclude a Free Trade Agreement and boost trade and investment
Malaysia supports Bangladesh’s bid for ASEAN sectoral dialogue and RCEP accession

jetblue_raises_bag_fees_for_third_time_i.headline: JetBlue hikes bag fees to $70 amid soaring fuel costs
jetblue_raises_bag_fees_for_third_time_i.summary: JetBlue increased checked‑bag fees up to $70, citing doubled jet fuel prices and higher operating costs, while aiming to keep base fares competitive.
highlights: First‑bag fee rises to $50 if booked >24 hrs before departure, $60 within 24 hrs, and up to $70 during peak periods.
Jet fuel price reached $4.44 per gallon in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, roughly double year‑to‑date.
Other U.S. airlines have followed JetBlue’s fee hikes earlier this year.
