apple_warns_of_risks_related_to_ai_agent.headline: Apple Flags Unpredictable AI Agents as Legal and Reputation Risk
apple_warns_of_risks_related_to_ai_agent.summary: Apple warns that autonomous AI agents could expose the company to lawsuits, reputational damage, and regulatory challenges due to unintended actions.
highlights: Apple’s filing lists AI agents accessing internal systems, altering code, and completing transactions as new risk factors.
Recent incidents like the Hugging Face breach highlight how rogue agents can escape sandboxes and hack third‑party sites.
Apple announced tighter full‑disk access controls on Macs to limit AI agent privileges.

crowdstrike_launches_ai_kill_switch_that.headline: CrowdStrike Unveils AI Kill Switch to Halt Rogue Agents
crowdstrike_launches_ai_kill_switch_that.summary: CrowdStrike introduced an AI kill switch within its Falcon Guardian platform, enabling security teams to stop rogue internal AI agents and block network access.
highlights: The kill switch acts like a circuit breaker, requiring human approval to cut off AI agents
CrowdStrike announced integration with Anthropic’s Claude Cowork and plans to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode

bsec_eases_restrictions_on_frozen_bo_acc.headline: DSE rebounds as BSEC eases frozen BO account restrictions
bsec_eases_restrictions_on_frozen_bo_acc.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange rallied 1.08% to 5,341.63 after BSEC partially unfroze BO accounts, reviving investor sentiment despite lower turnover.
highlights: 74% of traded securities closed higher, with paper stocks leading sector gains at 2.7%
Non‑Bank Financial Institutions rose 1.69%, the top sector performer

speedy_wage_revision_promised_by_bgmea_a.institution: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA) / Bangladesh Knitwear Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BKMEA)
speedy_wage_revision_promised_by_bgmea_a.headline: BGMEA and BKMEA Push Fast Wage Revision, Call RMG Workers Back
speedy_wage_revision_promised_by_bgmea_a.summary: The newly formed Minimum Wage Board began urgent deliberations, promising a rapid wage increase while industry leaders urged RMG workers to resume jobs for industrial peace.
highlights: Minimum Wage Board held its first meeting three days after formation and scheduled a second meeting on 9 November.
BGMEA President Mahmud Hasan Khan and BKMEA President Mohammad Hatem urged workers to return and warned against disruptions.
BKMEA proposed rent‑control enforcement, family cards, industrial hospitals, and dormitories to accompany wage hikes.

uniform_rates_digital_system_proposed_fo.headline: Bangladesh Proposes Uniform Construction Rates and Digital Portal for Public Projects
uniform_rates_digital_system_proposed_fo.summary: A government committee aims to standardize base rates, introduce regional adjustments, and launch a digital system to align public construction costs with market prices.
highlights: Uniform base rates and cost analysis to be approved within three months
Regional adjustments and a web portal will address transport cost disparities in remote areas

inflation_4_flash_estimate.headline: Euro Zone Inflation Reaches 4% as ECB Rate Hike Looms
inflation_4_flash_estimate.summary: Euro area inflation rose to a three‑year high of 4% in October, driven by surging energy costs, prompting markets to price a likely ECB rate increase.
highlights: Energy inflation climbed to 20.8% in October from 18.9% in September
Lithuania recorded the highest inflation at 6.1% while Malta posted the lowest at 2.3%
Markets see over 72% probability of an ECB rate hike in December

split_off_drugstore_business.headline: CVS to Split Pharmacy and Insurance Units, Shares Drop 10%
split_off_drugstore_business.summary: CVS Health will separate its retail pharmacy from its insurance and PBM operations by early 2028, reversing the $78 billion Aetna acquisition.
highlights: Shares fell about 10% after the breakup announcement.
The insurance and PBM unit will keep the CVS Health name, while the pharmacy unit will be called CVS Pharmacy.

divest_north_american_coffee_business_65.headline: Kraft Heinz to Sell North American Coffee Unit for $650 Million
divest_north_american_coffee_business_65.summary: Kraft Heinz will divest its North American coffee business, retaining a 30% stake, and use $500 million of post‑tax proceeds to reduce debt and boost growth.
highlights: Deal valued at $650 million enterprise basis, includes Maxwell House and Gevalia, and is expected to close in mid‑2027.
Shares rose about 5% after third‑quarter earnings beat expectations and the 2026 outlook was raised.

sg_trade_coop.headline: Singapore Seeks Expanded Trade, Tech and Energy Ties with Bangladesh
sg_trade_coop.summary: During a Dhaka visit, Singapore’s High Commissioner Derek Loh urged deeper cooperation with Bangladesh in AI, cybersecurity, energy projects and port development.
highlights: High Commissioner Derek Loh met senior Bangladeshi ministers and opposition leaders in Dhaka.
Discussions covered AI, cybersecurity, energy cooperation and PSA’s proposed Bay Terminal port project.

mrt_line1_contracts.headline: Bangladesh Signs Four Contracts for MRT Line‑1 Underground Construction
mrt_line1_contracts.summary: The government and JICA have signed four contracts covering 9.63 km of tunnels, stations and systems, advancing Dhaka’s first underground metro rail project.
highlights: Packages CP‑04 and CP‑06 will build 9.629 km of underground route between Rampura, Notun Bazar, Nadda and Airport stations.
Package CP‑09 handles track works; CP‑10 includes signalling, telecommunications, platform screen doors and an enterprise
Project financed jointly by Bangladesh government and Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).

bd_ageing_report.headline: Bangladesh Faces Tight Window to Create Jobs Before Aging Becomes a Burden
bd_ageing_report.summary: With a 24‑year transition, Bangladesh must generate formal jobs, expand social protection and boost female labour participation before its population ages.
highlights: Bangladesh will be classified as an ageing society by 2027 and as an aged society by 2051.
Formal employment growth has fallen to the bottom quartile of 82 emerging economies, with small firms shedding workers at ~5%
Female labour‑force participation is only 40%, and raising it to upper‑middle‑income levels could add up to 13% to GDP per

overseas_mining_expansion.headline: China Centralizes Overseas Mining to Tighten Grip on Critical Minerals
overseas_mining_expansion.summary: Beijing is coordinating state-owned firms to increase stakes in foreign mines, aiming to secure lithium, nickel, cobalt and rare earths amid rising geopolitical competition.
highlights: Chinese overseas mineral acquisitions hit $8.8 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, the highest since 2018.
China controls about 92% of global refined rare earth production, allowing it to manipulate supply and prices.
Host nations like Indonesia now require local processing, prompting Chinese firms to build smelting capacity abroad.

q3_revenue_beat.headline: Uber Beats Revenue Forecast as Freight Surges, Mobility Lags
q3_revenue_beat.summary: Uber posted $14.77 billion revenue, beating estimates, while its mobility unit fell short and freight sales jumped 34% and the company aims to expand driverless vehicles by 2027.
highlights: Mobility revenue declined 2% to $7.52 billion, missing forecasts
Freight sales rose 34% to $1.76 billion, driving the overall revenue beat
Uber committed $10 billion to driverless vehicle development and plans 2,000 automated cars by 2027

q3_earnings_miss.headline: Snapchat Parent Snap Shares Drop Over 10% After Revenue Miss
q3_earnings_miss.summary: Snap reported Q3 revenue of $1.72 billion, missing forecasts, and daily active users fell short, prompting a more than 10% plunge in its stock.
highlights: Revenue was $1.72 billion versus the $1.73 billion expected
Global daily active users reached 495 million, below the 499 million consensus
Adjusted earnings of $383 million beat analysts’ $337 million estimate

mou_on_economic_infrastructure_cooperati.institution: Invest Bangladesh & China Railway Construction Corp.
mou_on_economic_infrastructure_cooperati.headline: Bangladesh and China Railway Sign MoU to Boost Mongla Infrastructure Investment
mou_on_economic_infrastructure_cooperati.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman witnessed Invest Bangladesh and China Railway signing a MoU to expand investment in infrastructure, transport and energy sectors at Mongla.
highlights: The MoU covers sectors such as infrastructure, transport, logistics, industry and energy.
Prime Minister will lay foundation stones for two new container jetties at Mongla port.

pm_plans_energy_infrastructure_from_mong.headline: Bangladesh Plans Power and Gas Infrastructure from Mongla to North, Seeks More Chinese Investment
pm_plans_energy_infrastructure_from_mong.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced accelerated development of electricity and gas networks linking Mongla with northern Bangladesh, while urging increased Chinese investment under a new MoU.
highlights: Bangladesh and China Railway Construction Corporation signed an MoU for infrastructure cooperation
Government will fast‑track projects to ensure adequate electricity and gas supplies across the corridor

bb_sells_100m_to_stabilise_forex_market.headline: Bangladesh Bank sells $100m to stabilise forex market
bb_sells_100m_to_stabilise_forex_market.summary: Bangladesh Bank auctioned $100 million from reserves to curb rising import costs and support the Tk 124‑plus dollar rate amid global oil price declines.
highlights: Central bank sold $100 million after a $122 million auction last week
Reserves fell to $36.43 billion from $37.41 billion after recent sales
Dollar rate rose above Tk 124 in the interbank market

cvs_breakup_plan.headline: CVS Health to Split Pharmacy and Insurance Units by 2028
cvs_breakup_plan.summary: CVS Health will separate its retail pharmacy from Aetna and Caremark, aiming to unlock value as each unit gains independent focus.
highlights: Split creates two publicly traded companies, with roughly 9,000 stores in the pharmacy arm.
Operating cash flow expected to rise to $15.5 billion in 2026, a 70% increase since 2024.
Shares fell about 12% after the announcement despite a strong earnings streak.

adp_private_job_growth_october.headline: Private Companies Add 86,000 Jobs in October, ADP Reports
adp_private_job_growth_october.summary: Private sector employment rose by 86,000 in October, driven mainly by service jobs, while pay gains accelerated for job‑changers and overall workers.
highlights: Trade, transportation and utilities added 39,000 jobs, the largest sector gain.
Professional and business services lost 27,000 jobs, offsetting overall growth.
Workers changing jobs saw a 4.8% annual salary increase, the fastest since March 2024.

energy_demand_outlook.headline: Energy CEOs Forecast a Demand Decade Amid Investment Challenges
energy_demand_outlook.summary: BP, Baker Hughes and RWE CEOs say rising energy demand will drive a decade of capital spending, but geopolitical risks and higher rates create a tough investment climate.
highlights: Baker Hughes CEO Lorenzo Simonelli predicts low‑single‑digit industry growth in 2027 driven by AI and population expansion
RWE CEO Markus Krebber warns that higher interest rates and supply‑chain pressures complicate new electricity projects
BP CEO Meg O'Neill expects oil prices to stay low, prompting planning for a lower‑price environment

5_year_extension_request_for_banks_capit.headline: BSEC Pushes Five‑Year Extension for Banks’ Capital Market Funds
5_year_extension_request_for_banks_capit.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission is urging Bangladesh Bank to prolong banks’ Tk200 crore special capital market funds by five years to ease liquidity strain.
highlights: Over 30 banks currently use the special Tk200 crore fund to invest in the stock market.
BSEC and the DSE Brokers Association jointly request a five‑year extension and a fund size increase to Tk300 crore per bank.
Bangladesh Bank will assess extension requests on a case‑by‑case basis rather than granting a blanket renewal.

long_term_lng_lpg_supply_talks_with_russ.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
long_term_lng_lpg_supply_talks_with_russ.headline: Bangladesh Pursues Long‑Term LNG and LPG Imports from Russia
long_term_lng_lpg_supply_talks_with_russ.summary: Dhaka officials discussed securing Russian LNG from Sakhalin‑2 and Portovaya and establishing alternative payment channels to bypass sanctions on bilateral trade.
highlights: Gazprom offered to mediate talks between Petrobangla and Sakhalin Energy for LNG supply
Russia proposes using Indian rupees and digital instruments for trade settlements amid sanctions
Bangladesh paid $1.36 billion for Russian imports in FY25

push_for_more_chinese_investment_and_mon.headline: Bangladesh Seeks More Chinese Investment, Expands Industry in Mongla
push_for_more_chinese_investment_and_mon.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced plans to attract additional Chinese investment and develop power and gas infrastructure to expand industrial activity from Mongla to northern Bangladesh.
highlights: MoU signed between Invest Bangladesh and China Railway Construction Corporation (CRCC) for economic and infrastructure cooperation
Government will develop electricity and gas supply lines from Mongla toward northern regions
Aim to establish new industries in Mongla to boost regional economic activity

market_cap_loss.headline: Tesla and SpaceX Lose $420 Billion After Midterm Election Shock
market_cap_loss.summary: Shares of Tesla and SpaceX plunged on Thursday, wiping out over $420 billion in combined market value as Democrats seized congressional control, raising regulatory concerns.
highlights: Tesla shares fell 11% and SpaceX shares fell 9% on Thursday
Combined market‑cap loss exceeded $420 billion since Tuesday
Democrats took control of the House and Senate, increasing regulatory risk for Musk’s companies

magnificent_7_trillion_loss.headline: Tech Sell‑off Erases Over $1 Trillion from Magnificent Seven Valuations
magnificent_7_trillion_loss.summary: Thursday’s market rout saw the Nasdaq tumble over 5%, the Dow drop more than 1,800 points, and the Magnificent Seven lose more than $1 trillion in value.
highlights: Nasdaq Composite fell more than 5%, its worst day since April 4 2025.
Nvidia led the decline, shedding over $440 billion in market cap and dropping 9%.
VIX surged 11.57 points, its biggest jump since April 4 2025.

correction_entry.headline: Nasdaq Slides Into Correction as Midterms Spark Market Volatility
correction_entry.summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell over 5% into correction territory after Democratic midterm wins, with historical patterns suggesting near‑term selling before a three‑month rebound.
highlights: Nasdaq dropped more than 5% on Thursday, ending 11% below its recent record
Past corrections have yielded an average 9.41% gain within three months and 17.03% within six months, except the 2022 correction
Chip stocks slumped, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) down 12%, its worst day since March 2020

eu_fta_preparation_fasttrack.headline: Bangladesh urged to fast‑track EU Free‑Trade Agreement ahead of LDC graduation
eu_fta_preparation_fasttrack.summary: Experts say Bangladesh must swiftly negotiate an EU FTA and implement reforms to protect export competitiveness as it prepares to exit the LDC status by 2029.
highlights: An EU FTA could diversify exports beyond readymade garments and attract technology‑intensive investment.
Graduation from LDC status will affect Bangladesh’s eligibility for the EU’s GSP+ scheme.

business_approval_time_18_days.headline: Bangladesh to Slash Business License Approvals to 18 Days
business_approval_time_18_days.summary: The government aims to reduce startup licence processing from up to 355 days to 18 days, targeting a 14‑day goal to attract foreign investment.
highlights: Invest Bangladesh roadmap sets interim 18‑day target, with 11 services slated for one‑day delivery

green_sukuk_maturity_gap.headline: Beximco Green‑Sukuk Faces Repayment Gap, Extension Hangs on Land Transfer

q1_profit_dip.headline: IT Consultants Q1 Profit Falls 42% Amid Strong Cash Flow
q1_profit_dip.summary: IT Consultants PLC reported a 42% drop in earnings per share to Tk0.53 in Q1 FY27, while net operating cash flow per share rose to Tk1.
highlights: EPS fell from Tk0.92 to Tk0.53 year‑on‑year.
Shares closed at Tk38.30, down 3.53%.

softbank_swings_to_7_billion_net_loss_in.headline: SoftBank Posts $7 Billion Net Loss Amid AI Data‑Center Selloff
softbank_swings_to_7_billion_net_loss_in.summary: SoftBank reported a 1.12 trillion‑yen loss for Q2, driven by investment declines and higher financing costs despite revenue growth in AI computing.
highlights: Revenue rose 13.3% to 2.22 trillion yen, beating LSEG forecasts
Vision Fund segment swung to an 81.58 billion‑yen loss after a year‑earlier profit
Shares closed up 13.9% as Asian tech stocks rallied

china_s_monthly_imports_grow_at_fastest_.headline: China’s Imports Surge 41.6% in October, Surplus Tops $1 Trillion
china_s_monthly_imports_grow_at_fastest_.summary: October saw China’s imports jump 41.6% driven by tech goods and energy, while the trade surplus reached $1.04 trillion year‑to‑date despite a falling monthly surplus.
highlights: Imports of high‑tech products rose 72% year‑on‑year in October
Crude oil, LNG and coal imports grew 41%, 50% and 60% respectively
Exports to the U.S. increased 32.9%, creating a $32.7 billion surplus

trump_administration_proposes_stricter_w.headline: Trump Administration Proposes Tougher Work‑Search Rules for Unemployment Benefits
trump_administration_proposes_stricter_w.summary: The Labor Department's new rule would require claimants to document five weekly work‑search activities, raising eligibility standards and prompting concerns over state costs and applicant hardship.
highlights: The proposal mandates at least five qualifying work‑search activities each week before benefits are paid.
Only four states currently enforce a five‑search minimum, while most states require fewer.
Long‑term unemployment rose to 27.6% in October, up from 20.5% three years earlier.

third_terminal_operating_agreement_with_.headline: Caab Board Clears Draft Deal for Japanese Consortium to Run Dhaka Airport Third Terminal
third_terminal_operating_agreement_with_.summary: The Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh approved a draft agreement allowing a Japanese consortium to operate the third terminal at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, pending ministerial sign‑off.
highlights: The board’s decision now moves to the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism for final approval.
The $2.1 billion terminal, financed by JICA, needs an additional Tk902 crore to become operational.
Once active, capacity will rise to 16‑22 million passengers annually, doubling current levels.

beximco_tk3_000_cr_sukuk_maturity_risk.headline: ICB faces bind over Beximco Tk2,800 crore Green Sukuk maturity
beximco_tk3_000_cr_sukuk_maturity_risk.summary: The Investment Corporation of Bangladesh must decide how to repay the Tk2,800 crore Beximco Green Sukuk by December amid legal constraints and banking exposure.
highlights: Twenty-two banks risk losses if the sukuk defaults.
Foreign firms Revival Global and Adsum Capital show interest in the Teesta Solar project.

extension_of_negative_equity_adjustment_.headline: BSEC Extends Negative‑Equity Adjustment Deadline for Brokers and Merchant Banks to 2030
extension_of_negative_equity_adjustment_.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission gave stockbrokers and merchant banks until 2030 to provision and fully resolve negative equity and unrealised losses, while imposing investor‑protective restrictions.
highlights: Institutions must provision at least 25% of negative equity annually from 2027 and fully adjust by 2030.
Fresh negative equity incurred in 2026 must be fully provisioned within the same year.
Brokers cannot extend margin loans, charge interest, or pay dividends on affected BO accounts during the adjustment period.

oct2026_cpi_breakdown.headline: October CPI Shows Persistent Inflation Amid Housing and Energy Pressures
oct2026_cpi_breakdown.summary: The CPI rose 0.4% in October, driven by housing costs and higher energy prices, keeping inflation well above the Fed’s 2% target.
highlights: Core CPI increased 0.3% for the third consecutive month.
Gasoline prices fell 1% after a 9.1% surge in September.
Shelter index contributed over 30% of the monthly CPI rise.

ipo_announcement.headline: Anthropic IPO Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation, Retail Access Remains Limited
highlights: Mutual funds and ETFs can hold private AI firms like Anthropic before they list publicly
Special purpose vehicles (SPVs) now account for up to 50% of secondary market pre‑IPO transactions
Online platforms such as Forge and EquityZen let accredited investors trade private shares with lower minimums

q3_earnings.headline: CoreWeave’s Debt‑Heavy AI Expansion Faces Investor Scrutiny Ahead of Q3 Report
q3_earnings.summary: CoreWeave’s soaring debt and massive capex raise concerns as investors await details on financing and future cash flow in its Q3 earnings.
highlights: Stock has fallen about 40% in the past month, trading near $47.
Debt‑to‑equity ratio rose to 702% and 9.75% bond yields hit 15.5%.
Capex guidance targets up to $13.5 billion this quarter and $39 billion for the year.

rmg_factory_suspensions_unrest.institution: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA)
rmg_factory_suspensions_unrest.headline: Bangladesh RMG Sector Faces Halt as 146 Factories Suspend Work
rmg_factory_suspensions_unrest.summary: Fresh labour unrest in Ashulia and Gazipur forced 146 garment factories to stop production, threatening exports and prompting owners to consider indefinite closures.
highlights: Over 100 of the halted factories are in the Ashulia industrial belt.
Owners may invoke Section 13(1) of the Bangladesh Labour Act for indefinite shutdowns.
International buyers like Marks & Spencer are shifting orders to India amid the unrest.

financial_inclusion_report_2025.headline: Bangladesh financial inclusion hits 64.5% as mobile services surge
financial_inclusion_report_2025.summary: Bangladesh Bank reports 64.5% of adults now using formal financial services, while student and marginal farmer savings fell despite strong mobile and agent banking growth.
highlights: MFS transactions rose 25.58% to Tk21.83 lakh crore
School banking accounts grew 8.57% but deposits fell 3.69%
Agent banking outlets fell 3.5% while deposits rose 19%

motijheel_building_possession.headline: BASIC Bank Secures Motijheel Headquarters After Decade‑Long Legal Battle
motijheel_building_possession.summary: State‑owned BASIC Bank took possession of its Motijheel building, ending a ten‑year court fight and plans to finish construction and relocate its head office.
highlights: Court order on 9 Nov 2026 mandated handover of the 51,500 sq ft Motijheel property to BASIC Bank.
The building, purchased in 2010, remained unfinished until the eviction drive executed by law enforcement.
Relocating the headquarters is expected to generate significant cost savings for the bank.

credit_card_debt_record_1_29trn.institution: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
credit_card_debt_record_1_29trn.headline: US Credit Card Debt Hits Record $1.29 Trillion Amid Rising Costs
credit_card_debt_record_1_29trn.summary: Household credit card balances surged to a record $1.29 trillion, up 4.2% YoY, as inflation and borrowing costs push more Americans into debt.
highlights: Total household debt reached a record $19.1 trillion.
Average credit card APR is about 24%.
Number of credit card holders rose to 178 million.

around_50_rmg_factories_suspend_operatio.headline: Around 50 RMG Factories Halt Production Amid Worker-Police Clashes in Ashulia
around_50_rmg_factories_suspend_operatio.summary: Garment workers in Ashulia protested for higher minimum wages, leading to work stoppages at about 50 factories and tense confrontations with police.
highlights: Approximately 50 factories announced holidays after workers blocked roads
Police used tear gas and sound grenades to disperse demonstrators
Only a few factories such as Ha-Meem and Ananta remained operational

bangladesh_among_4_lowest_ranked_countri.headline: Bangladesh Ranks Among Lowest in AI Awareness and Usage
bangladesh_among_4_lowest_ranked_countri.summary: A Gallup‑Microsoft survey finds only 10% of Bangladeshis have used AI, placing the country fourth from bottom among 37 nations surveyed.
highlights: 64.2% of respondents have never heard of AI
Daily AI usage in Bangladesh is 1.8%, the second‑lowest among surveyed countries

chittagong_chamber_seeks_ilo_partnership.headline: Chittagong Chamber Partners with ILO to Bridge Skills Gap
chittagong_chamber_seeks_ilo_partnership.summary: The Chittagong Chamber of Commerce and Industry has sought an ILO partnership to launch employment support services, aligning vocational training with industry needs in Bangladesh.
highlights: ILO will introduce employment support services in Chattogram to connect jobseekers with employers
CCCI President Amirul Haque calls for short‑term, occupation‑based training like plumbing and sewing to meet industrial demand
Government plans to set up employment exchange centres nationwide with ILO technical assistance

investors_pivot_to_defensive_stocks_as_m.headline: Investors Shift to Defensive Stocks as Markets Enter Alert State
investors_pivot_to_defensive_stocks_as_m.summary: Investors are moving from volatile tech bets to defensive sectors amid AI‑related capex concerns and political uncertainty, signaling a market alert.
highlights: Nasdaq Composite Index is up 8.7% YTD but down 0.7% in November
MSCI World Information Technology index fell 7% in October and 4.6% this month
Consumer Staples, Healthcare and Utilities sectors posted broad gains over the past month

u_s_china_should_harbor_no_illusions_as_.headline: U.S., China to Balance AI Cooperation and Competition, Says Treasury Secretary
u_s_china_should_harbor_no_illusions_as_.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the U.S. and China to cooperate on AI risk management while openly competing for global dominance.
highlights: New U.S.-China dialogue on "super intelligence" will exchange best‑practice testing protocols
Both nations maintain export controls on advanced chips despite the cooperation framework

alibaba_announces_plans_to_list_t_head_i.headline: Alibaba to Spin Off T‑Head Semiconductor Unit on Hong Kong Exchange
alibaba_announces_plans_to_list_t_head_i.summary: Alibaba plans a Hong Kong IPO for its AI chip maker T‑Head, pending regulator approval, as Chinese tech firms push domestic semiconductors amid U.S. restrictions.
highlights: Alibaba filed a confidential listing request for T‑Head on Sep. 11.
T‑Head’s upcoming Zhenwu V900 AI chip claims three‑fold performance over its predecessor.
Alibaba shares fell 1% after the announcement, down about 29% year‑to‑date.

dollar_rate_crosses_tk125_as_fuel_import.headline: Bangladesh Taka Falls Past Tk125 Amid Surge in Fuel Import Payments
dollar_rate_crosses_tk125_as_fuel_import.summary: The dollar rate crossed Tk125 as rising fuel import costs and limited reserve sales intensified pressure on the Bangladeshi taka in November.
highlights: Commercial banks bought dollars at Tk125.10‑125.15 after the central bank sold $122 million from reserves
Petroleum import costs jumped 27.87% to $2.98 billion, driving higher dollar demand
Remittances reached $30.80 billion but monthly inflows stayed below $3 billion for five months

bangladesh_to_host_first_international_p.headline: Bangladesh to Host First International Public Debt Management Conference
bangladesh_to_host_first_international_p.summary: Bangladesh will host a two‑day conference in Cox’s Bazar, gathering about 100 delegates from 30 nations to discuss debt sustainability, borrowing risks and new financing sources.
highlights: Around 100 delegates from 30 countries will attend, representing finance ministries and debt agencies.
The conference is organized by Bangladesh’s Finance Division with support from the Asian Development Bank.
Topics include IMF and World Bank framework changes and mobilising private capital for public investment.

govt_targets_10_000mw_solar_power_genera.institution: Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Ministry
govt_targets_10_000mw_solar_power_genera.headline: Bangladesh Aims for 10,000MW Solar Capacity in Five Years
govt_targets_10_000mw_solar_power_genera.summary: The government pledges to generate 30% of electricity from solar, targeting 10,000 MW in five years while promoting rooftop systems and battery storage.
highlights: National Solar Expo attracted thousands, boosting public interest in solar energy
Over 8,000 providers responded to the government tender for solar services
The state will purchase surplus rooftop solar power at Tk10 per unit, earning households Tk2 per unit

goolsbee_inflation_comment.headline: Fed's Goolsbee Calls Latest Inflation Data Borderline Disturbing
goolsbee_inflation_comment.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee warned that the October CPI surge, rising 0.4%, signals a real inflation issue as the Fed weighs further rate hikes.
highlights: CPI rose 0.4% in October, marking a third consecutive month of outsized price increases.
Fed officials Waller and Logan hint at possible half‑point or multiple quarter‑point hikes in December.
Fed funds futures now price a 15% chance of a half‑point rate rise at the December meeting.

kalshi_investigation.headline: CFTC Probes Kalshi Over Self‑Certified Event Contracts Submission
kalshi_investigation.summary: The CFTC is investigating whether Kalshi failed to properly notify the agency about certain weather‑related event contracts, citing a procedural filing error.
highlights: Kalshi says the issue involves a handful of contracts, many not yet live
The CFTC ordered Kalshi to remove sports‑related “mention markets” in August
Regulators are increasing scrutiny of prediction markets ahead of the new Democratic Congress

share_rebound_after_scandal.headline: Nvidia Shares Rebound Amid CEO Scandal Ahead of Earnings
share_rebound_after_scandal.summary: Nvidia stock rose 3% after two days of decline as investors weigh the impact of CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged spy affair on upcoming earnings.
highlights: Nvidia hired law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to probe potential security breaches
Bank of America outlined three risk scenarios ranging from contained impact to escalated valuation pressure
Morgan Stanley removed Nvidia from its top‑pick list after a 25% share drop

ashulia_factories_closure_consideration.headline: RMG Owners Mull Indefinite Closure of 210 Ashulia Factories
ashulia_factories_closure_consideration.summary: Garment owners plan to shut 210 Ashulia factories indefinitely amid ongoing labour unrest, affecting 300,000 workers and risking export order fulfillment.
highlights: 210 factories in Ashulia, Jamgora and Hemayetpur face possible indefinite closure
Around 300,000 workers employed by major manufacturers such as Ha-Meem and New Age are affected
Owners can invoke Section 13(1) of the Labour Act to close factories without wage obligations

subsidised_rice_for_rmg_workers.headline: Bangladesh Launches Subsidised Rice Scheme for RMG Workers
subsidised_rice_for_rmg_workers.summary: The government will sell rice at Tk30 per kg to garment workers, subsidised by taxpayers, to ease living costs amid wage protests.
highlights: Each eligible worker can buy up to 10 kg of rice monthly, with sales conducted every Friday from 75 trucks.
The programme initially allocates 4,500 tonnes of rice, costing an estimated Tk8.55 crore in subsidy for FY27.

yarn_import_guarantee_restriction.headline: Bangladesh Yarn Import Guarantee Remains Sub Judice, Exporters Face Cash‑Flow Strain
yarn_import_guarantee_restriction.summary: Garment exporters in Bangladesh must continue providing 100% bank guarantees for yarn imports, as a court case keeps the policy sub judice and cash‑flow tight.
highlights: Existing rule ties guarantees to the full value of imported yarn
Exporters claim the requirement locks up working capital, especially for SMEs

jensen_huang_affair_in_d_c_resignation_c.headline: Congress Demands Nvidia CEO Resign Over China Spy Affair
jensen_huang_affair_in_d_c_resignation_c.summary: U.S. lawmakers are urging Nvidia chief Jensen Huang to step down after admitting an affair with a woman identified as a Chinese intelligence operative.
highlights: Senate and House committees have subpoena authority and are considering compelling Huang to testify
Proposed legislation like the AI Overwatch Act aims to tighten export controls on advanced AI chips to China

nissan_cuts_sales_forecast_again_on_chin.headline: Nissan Slashes Sales Forecast, Boosts China‑Developed Exports to Fight Rivals
nissan_cuts_sales_forecast_again_on_chin.summary: Nissan cut its FY2027 sales target to 3 million vehicles while expanding China‑developed model exports from two to five to counter fierce local competition.
highlights: Export push aims at 12 regional market clusters in the near term
Turnaround plan has delivered 365 billion yen in cost savings and a 15% workforce reduction

bangladesh_afd_agree_on_140m_future_fina.headline: Bangladesh and AFD Seal €140 Million Climate and Water Financing Roadmap
bangladesh_afd_agree_on_140m_future_fina.summary: Bangladesh and the French Development Agency agreed on a €140 million roadmap delivering climate policy loans and water‑sanitation financing, while planning future cooperation in skills and TVET.
highlights: AFD will provide a €100 million climate policy loan in 2027 and €40 million for water supply and sanitation in 2028.
The agreement also includes exploring non‑sovereign financing, TVET and skills development for 2029–2030.

bangladesh_seeks_low_interest_long_term_.headline: Bangladesh Pushes for Low‑Interest Financing and Fair Trade to Boost Green Industry
bangladesh_seeks_low_interest_long_term_.summary: Bangladesh seeks low‑interest, long‑term loans, fair pricing for green products and supportive trade policies to accelerate rooftop solar expansion and LEED‑certified manufacturing.
highlights: Over 600 MW of rooftop solar capacity is already installed and the government targets 10,000 MW by 2030.
More than 290 garment factories hold LEED certification, with over 120 achieving Platinum status.
Bangladesh plans a national carbon market and aims to plant 250 million trees.

tata_projects_japanese_firms_win_dhaka_m.headline: Tata Projects and Japanese Partners Win Dhaka Metro Underground Contract
tata_projects_japanese_firms_win_dhaka_m.summary: Tata Projects, together with Nishimatsu Construction and Toda Corporation, secured a JICA‑funded 5.2‑km underground segment of Dhaka Metro, including three stations.
highlights: Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited (DMTCL) awarded Contract Package CP06 for the 5.2‑km underground line
Funding support comes from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
The project includes underground stations at Khilkhet, Airport Terminal 3 and Airport

yields_edge_higher.headline: Treasury Yields Rise Ahead of Inflation and Housing Data Release
yields_edge_higher.summary: U.S. Treasury yields nudged higher on Thursday as traders await October producer price inflation and home sales data for clues on the Fed’s policy path.
highlights: 10-year Treasury yield rose 2 basis points to 5.0100%
2-year Treasury yield increased 5 basis points to 4.7800%
Producer price inflation expected to rise 0.4% in October, down from September’s 1.3% surge

board_meeting_ceo_fate.headline: Nvidia Board Deliberates CEO Jensen Huang’s Future Amid Scandal
board_meeting_ceo_fate.summary: Nvidia’s board convened late Wednesday to decide whether to remove CEO Jensen Huang after revelations of extramarital affairs and alleged ties to a Chinese spy.
highlights: Shares fell over 9% in after‑hours trading following the board’s investigation announcement
Independent probe hired law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to examine spying allegations

director_fines_unpaid_dividends.headline: BSEC fines directors Tk29.09 crore for unpaid cash dividends
director_fines_unpaid_dividends.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission imposed Tk29.09 crore in fines on managing and non‑independent directors of ten listed firms for missing statutory dividend deadlines.
highlights: Directors of Lub‑rref faced the highest individual fine of Tk2.35 crore each
Daily penalties of Tk10,000 per day apply to ongoing dividend defaults
BSEC rejected firms’ operational excuses, stressing mandatory investor entitlements

msci_frontier_additions.headline: Six Bangladeshi Firms Added to MSCI Frontier Markets Index
msci_frontier_additions.summary: Beximco Pharma, LafargeHolcim Bangladesh and four banks join the MSCI Frontier Markets Index, boosting their visibility to international investors after the November review.
highlights: Beximco Pharmaceuticals, LafargeHolcim Bangladesh, BRAC Bank, City Bank, Eastern Bank and Prime Bank are the six new constituents.
Bangladesh Export Import Company, Renata, Robi Axiata and United Power Generation are removed from the index.
MSCI added 83 stocks to the Frontier Markets Small Cap Index for Bangladesh.

nbfi_cfo_cso_eligibility.headline: Bangladesh Bank Tightens Eligibility for CFOs, CSs, and CITOs at NBFIs
nbfi_cfo_cso_eligibility.summary: The central bank issued new qualification rules requiring senior finance officers to meet experience, education and integrity standards, with a compliance deadline of December 2029.
highlights: CFOs at institutions with loans over Tk1,000 crore need at least 10 years of banking experience and a postgraduate finance degree
Company secretaries must hold a Chartered Secretary qualification from the Institute of Chartered Secretaries of Bangladesh
All appointments must be full‑time; acting assignments are limited to three months

analysis_nvidia_s_leadership_crisis_test.headline: Nvidia Leadership Crisis Tests Its Role as AI ‘Central Bank’
analysis_nvidia_s_leadership_crisis_test.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises concerns that Nvidia’s massive AI‑finance commitments could transmit shocks through banks and markets despite its strong equity cushion.
highlights: Nvidia pledged up to $36 billion to buy cloud services from AI “neoclouds.”
The firm backs a $105 billion guarantee for an Ohio data‑center project and a $125 billion credit program.
Shares fell 33% from the October peak, yet analysts still forecast revenue doubling this year.

jensen_huang_s_nvidia_exit_casts_shadow_.headline: Nvidia CEO Exit Threatens $500 Billion AI Financing Drive
jensen_huang_s_nvidia_exit_casts_shadow_.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation has jolted Nvidia shares and put the $500 billion AI financing plan with major Wall Street lenders under heightened scrutiny.
highlights: Shares fell over 13% before narrowing losses after the resignation.
CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while a permanent successor remains unidentified.
Preliminary financing agreements involve Apollo Global Management, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR.

oil_prices_mixed_after_trump_says_no_ira.headline: Trump Claims US Controls Strait of Hormuz as Oil Prices Edge Higher
oil_prices_mixed_after_trump_says_no_ira.summary: Brent rose 1.1% to $93.73 while WTI edged up 0.3% after President Trump asserted the United States controls the Strait of Hormuz, dampening deal expectations.
highlights: Brent crude traded at $93.73 per barrel, up 1.1%.
WTI futures rose to $86.76 per barrel, up 0.3%.
Analysts warn renewed doubts on an Iran‑U.S. deal could raise the oil security premium.

the_1_3_trillion_climate_finance_promise.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Real Climate Finance Beyond $1.3 Trillion Promise
the_1_3_trillion_climate_finance_promise.summary: Bangladesh urges that the $1.3 trillion climate finance goal translates into grant‑based, equitable funding reaching vulnerable communities and protecting the Sundarbans.
highlights: Current business‑as‑usual climate finance is projected at $461 billion annually by 2035, far short of the $1.3 trillion target.
Private‑sector investment is expected to supply $882 billion, yet many adaptation projects lack commercial returns.
Bangladesh stresses the need for concessional grants to fund early warning systems, resilient infrastructure, and ecosystem

bangladesh_among_five_countries_selected.headline: Bangladesh Selected for CIF ARISE Climate Resilience Investment Programme
bangladesh_among_five_countries_selected.summary: Bangladesh joins four other nations in the CIF's ARISE programme, enabling up to $30 million in concessional financing to boost climate‑adaptation projects across key sectors.
highlights: The ARISE programme allows each selected country to seek up to US$30 million for climate‑resilient investment plans
Over US$100 million was pledged at launch by Germany, Spain and Ireland, with the United Kingdom adding up to US$128 million later

dcci_canada_trade_body_launch_5_year_pro.headline: Bangladesh SMEs Get Canadian Backing to Boost Jute Exports
dcci_canada_trade_body_launch_5_year_pro.summary: The DCCI‑Canada TRISEG project will support 200 Bangladeshi SMEs, especially jute producers, with training, finance and market links to expand exports to Canada.
highlights: Women entrepreneurs represent 67% of the 3,200 SMEs benefiting across 16 countries.
Bangladesh’s export earnings hit $48 billion in 2025, with Canada ranking among the top‑10 destinations at $1.5 billion.

nvidia_on_track_for_longest_weekly_losin.headline: Nvidia Faces Longest Weekly Decline Since 2012 After CEO Resignation
nvidia_on_track_for_longest_weekly_losin.summary: Nvidia’s market value plunged $1.6 trillion as shares fell 11% for the week, marking its longest losing streak since 2012 following Jensen Huang’s resignation.
highlights: Nvidia lost 29% of its value, falling below Apple in market cap
Finance chief Colette Kress was named interim CEO
Analysts forecast 91% year‑over‑year revenue growth to $108.9 billion for the next quarter

widespread_microsoft_outage_takes_down_o.headline: Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams and 365 Services Globally
widespread_microsoft_outage_takes_down_o.summary: A widespread outage that began Thursday afternoon crippled Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Copilot, forcing companies worldwide to delay earnings and reroute communications.
highlights: Microsoft applied a new patch and added virtual machine capacity to restore server stability
Air India rerouted emails but flight operations remained unaffected

in_a_policy_switch_the_fed_says_its_octo.headline: Fed Skips Vote on Interest Rates at October 2027 Meeting
in_a_policy_switch_the_fed_says_its_octo.summary: The Federal Reserve will forgo a rate‑vote at its October 2027 FOMC session, turning it into a strategic policy discussion.
highlights: October 2027 session will be non‑voting, focusing on broad monetary‑policy strategy.
Chairman Kevin Warsh cites streamlined communication and longer‑term deliberation as reasons.
Final 2027 meeting moved from December to November, increasing non‑voting meetings in 2028.

customs_irregularities_garment_exporters.headline: Customs Uncovers Tk1.59 Crore Export Irregularities at Two Bangladeshi Garment Firms
customs_irregularities_garment_exporters.summary: Customs officials found undeclared garments and illegal removal of bond‑facility fabrics, estimating over Tk1.59 crore in revenue loss and VAT evasion from Eagle Textiles and Reaz Knitwear.
highlights: Physical inspection revealed 173,349 garments across 14 categories, far exceeding Eagle Textiles' declared four categories.
Reaz Knitwear's shipment listed only men's polo shirts, yet 50 garment categories were uncovered.

rmg_workers_rice_subsidy_30tk_per_kg.headline: Special OMS Lets RMG Workers Buy Rice at Tk30/kg
rmg_workers_rice_subsidy_30tk_per_kg.summary: The Ministry of Food launches a pilot Open Market Sale program letting each RMG worker purchase up to 10 kg of rice each month for Tk30 per kilogram.
highlights: Rice will be sold from trucks every Friday in two shifts across Dhaka and Chattogram districts.
Purchases require garment factory ID cards and are recorded on factory‑maintained master rolls.
The programme is managed by the Directorate General of Food with monitoring teams ensuring transparency.

icc_global_banking_meeting_london.headline: Bangladesh Bankers Attend ICC Global Banking Commission Meeting in London
icc_global_banking_meeting_london.summary: A 26‑member delegation from nine Bangladeshi banks participated in the ICC Global Banking Commission’s annual meeting in London, joining roughly 400 international delegates.
highlights: The delegation was led by ICC Bangladesh Secretary General Ataur Rahman and included senior officials from Islami Bank, One
ICC Bangladesh will host the next Global Banking Commission meeting in Dhaka in November 2027.

ppi_october_2026.headline: Wholesale Prices Jump 6.5% Annually, Fueling Fed Rate Hike Speculation
ppi_october_2026.summary: The producer price index rose 0.3% in October, pushing the annual rate to 6.5%, the highest since November 2022 and prompting expectations of a Fed rate increase.
highlights: Core PPI matched expectations with a 0.3% monthly gain.
Goods index surged 10.2% year‑over‑year, the strongest since October 2022.

lutnick_testimony_nvidia_china_chip_sale.headline: Commerce Secretary Lutnick to Testify on Nvidia AI Chip Exports to China
lutnick_testimony_nvidia_china_chip_sale.summary: Howard Lutnick has agreed to appear before the Senate Banking Committee to address concerns that Nvidia’s AI chips may have been sold to Chinese firms, raising security issues.
highlights: Lutnick will testify on Dec. 10 after a Senate Banking Committee request
Lawmakers allege export control loopholes allowed Nvidia AI chip sales to China
Critics say the Trump administration omitted over 100 risky firms from the trade blacklist

crypto_rules_adoption.headline: CFTC Chair Selig Says Crypto Exchanges Embrace New Federal Rules Amid Legislative Stalemate
crypto_rules_adoption.summary: Chair Michael Selig reported growing interest from major and emerging crypto exchanges to register with the CFTC under its proposed digital‑asset rules after the Clarity Act failed.
highlights: Major crypto platforms are opting in to CFTC registration to offer spot trading alongside perpetual futures.
New entrants prefer a single federal regulator over navigating dozens of state licensing regimes.

evt_19e2d8adda.headline: Jute sales may fetch Tk549cr in Rajshahi this season

evt_bbd54b9ff0.headline: Bangladesh seeks US cooperation on SMRs, nuclear technology

evt_8f180adf60.headline: New pay scale likely to get cabinet nod Monday

evt_f9196eae7f.headline: BMW brought in 3-4 pieces to evade duties seized in Ctg: CIID

evt_5c72b070bd.headline: Iran war diplomacy turns toward reopening Strait of Hormuz
